title: Designing KRIYA: An AI Companion for Wellbeing Self-Reflection
summary: Most personal wellbeing apps present summative dashboards of health and physical activity metrics, yet many users struggle to translate this information into meaningful understanding. These apps commonly support engagement through goals, reminders, and structured targets, which can reinforce comparison, judgment, and performance anxiety. To explore a complementary approach that prioritizes self-reflection, we design KRIYA, an AI wellbeing companion that supports co-interpretive engagement with personal wellbeing data. KRIYA aims to collaborate with users to explore questions, explanations, and future scenarios through features such as Comfort Zone, Detective Mode, and What-If Planning. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 18 college students interacting with a KRIYA prototype using hypothetical data. Our findings show that through KRIYA interaction, users framed engaging with wellbeing data as interpretation rather than performance, experienced reflection as supportive or pressuring depending on emotional framing, and developed trust through transparency. We discuss design implications for AI companions that support curiosity, self-compassion, and reflective sensemaking of personal health data.

AI.title_translation: 设计KRIYA：一个支持健康自我反思的AI伙伴
AI.tldr: KRIYA是一个AI健康伙伴，旨在通过共同解释个人数据来支持自我反思，而非强调绩效和目标，研究发现用户更倾向于将其视为数据解读而不是绩效考核。
AI.motivation: 大多数现有健康应用侧重于总结性指标和目标，导致用户难以理解数据，并可能引发比较、评判和绩效焦虑。本文旨在探索一种优先考虑自我反思的补充性方法。
AI.method: 设计并开发了AI健康伙伴KRIYA的原型。使用假设数据与18名大学生进行了半结构化访谈。
AI.result: 用户将参与健康数据视为“解释”而非“绩效”；反思体验取决于情感框架（支持性或压力性）；透明度有助于建立信任。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了支持好奇心、自我同情和对个人健康数据进行反思性意义建构的AI伙伴的设计启示。
AI.translation: 大多数个人健康应用呈现健康和身体活动指标的总结性仪表板，但许多用户难以将这些信息转化为有意义的理解。这些应用通常通过目标、提醒和结构化指标来支持参与，这可能会加剧比较、评判和绩效焦虑。为了探索一种优先考虑自我反思的补充性方法，我们设计了KRIYA，一个支持个人健康数据共同解释性参与的AI健康伙伴。KRIYA旨在通过“舒适区”、“侦探模式”和“假设规划”等功能，与用户协作探索问题、解释和未来情景。我们对18名大学生进行了半结构化访谈，他们使用假设数据与KRIYA原型进行交互。我们的研究结果表明，通过与KRIYA的交互，用户将参与健康数据视为“解释”而非“绩效”；根据情感框架，反思体验可能是支持性的或带来压力的；透明度有助于建立信任。我们讨论了支持好奇心、自我同情和对个人健康数据进行反思性意义建构的AI伙伴的设计启示。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了KRIYA，一个旨在通过共同解释个人健康数据来促进自我反思的AI伙伴，以区别于传统健康应用中侧重绩效指标所带来的焦虑。KRIYA提供“舒适区”等功能，支持用户探索数据。对18名学生的访谈证实，这种方法使用户将数据视为解释对象而非绩效考核，并强调了设计中透明度对建立信任的重要性。
AI.keywords: AI伙伴, 健康, 自我反思, 共同解释, 个人数据
AI.comments: 创新点在于将健康应用的设计范式从以绩效为中心（易引发焦虑）转向以反思和共同解释为中心。KRIYA通过强调好奇心和自我同情，为AI健康伙伴提供了重要的设计启示。局限性在于研究使用了假设数据进行原型测试，可能无法完全反映用户在真实数据情境下的情感反应。

title: Counterfactual Modeling with Fine-Tuned LLMs for Health Intervention Design and Sensor Data Augmentation
summary:
Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) provide human-centric interpretability by identifying the minimal, actionable changes required to alter a machine learning model's prediction. Therefore, CFs can be used as (i) interventions for abnormality prevention and (ii) augmented data for training robust models. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of CF generation using large language models (LLMs), including GPT-4 (zero-shot and few-shot) and two open-source models-BioMistral-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, in both pretrained and fine-tuned configurations. Using the multimodal AI-READI clinical dataset, we assess CFs across three dimensions: intervention quality, feature diversity, and augmentation effectiveness. Fine-tuned LLMs, particularly LLaMA-3.1-8B, produce CFs with high plausibility (up to 99%), strong validity (up to 0.99), and realistic, behaviorally modifiable feature adjustments. When used for data augmentation under controlled label-scarcity settings, LLM-generated CFs substantially restore classifier performance, yielding an average 20% F1 recovery across three scarcity scenarios. Compared with optimization-based baselines such as DiCE, CFNOW, and NICE, LLMs offer a flexible, model-agnostic approach that generates more clinically actionable and semantically coherent counterfactuals. Overall, this work demonstrates the promise of LLM-driven counterfactuals for both interpretable intervention design and data-efficient model training in sensor-based digital health.
  Impact: SenseCF fine-tunes an LLM to generate valid, representative counterfactual explanations and supplement minority class in an imbalanced dataset for improving model training and boosting model robustness and predictive performance

AI.title_translation: 使用微调大型语言模型进行健康干预设计和传感器数据增强的反事实建模
AI.tldr: 本文评估了使用GPT-4、BioMistral-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B等LLM生成反事实解释（CFs）的能力，用于数字健康中的干预设计和数据增强。结果显示，微调后的LLMs（特别是LLaMA-3.1-8B）生成的CFs具有高可行性和有效性，并且在标签稀缺情景下，能平均恢复分类器20%的F1分数，优于传统的优化基线方法。
AI.motivation: 利用反事实解释（CFEs）提供以人为中心的解释性，识别改变模型预测所需的最小、可操作的改变。因此，CFs可用于 (i) 异常预防干预措施 和 (ii) 训练鲁棒模型的增强数据。
AI.method: 评估了使用大型语言模型（LLMs，包括GPT-4的零样本/少样本配置，以及BioMistral-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B的预训练和微调配置）生成CFs的能力。使用多模态AI-READI临床数据集，从干预质量、特征多样性和增强有效性三个维度评估CFs。
AI.result: 微调后的LLMs（特别是LLaMA-3.1-8B）生成的CFs具有高合理性（高达99%）和强有效性（高达0.99），且特征调整现实且行为可修改。在标签稀缺的数据增强设置中，LLM生成的CFs显著恢复了分类器性能，平均F1分数恢复了20%。LLMs提供了一种灵活、模型无关的方法，生成的反事实比DiCE、CFNOW和NICE等优化基线更具临床可操作性和语义连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证明了LLM驱动的反事实方法在传感器数字健康领域中，对于可解释的干预设计和数据高效的模型训练的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 反事实解释（CFEs）通过识别改变机器学习模型预测所需的最小、可操作的改变，提供了以人为中心的解释性。因此，CFs可用作 (i) 异常预防的干预措施 和 (ii) 训练鲁棒模型的增强数据。我们对使用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成反事实进行了全面评估，这些LLMs包括GPT-4（零样本和少样本）以及两个开源模型——BioMistral-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B，涵盖了预训练和微调配置。我们使用多模态AI-READI临床数据集，从干预质量、特征多样性和增强有效性三个维度评估CFs。微调后的LLMs，特别是LLaMA-3.1-8B，生成的CFs具有高合理性（高达99%）、强有效性（高达0.99），以及现实的、行为可修改的特征调整。当在受控的标签稀缺设置下用于数据增强时，LLM生成的CFs显著恢复了分类器性能，在三种稀缺场景下平均F1分数恢复了20%。与DiCE、CFNOW和NICE等基于优化的基线相比，LLMs提供了一种灵活、模型无关的方法，可以生成更具临床可操作性和语义连贯性的反事实。总而言之，这项工作证明了LLM驱动的反事实方法在传感器数字健康领域中，对于可解释的干预设计和数据高效的模型训练的巨大潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了使用微调的大型语言模型（LLMs，包括GPT-4、BioMistral-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B）生成反事实解释（CFEs）的能力，并将CFEs应用于数字健康中的干预设计和传感器数据增强。研究利用AI-READI临床数据集，从质量、多样性和增强效果三个方面进行评估。结果表明，微调后的LLMs，尤其是LLaMA-3.1-8B，能够生成高度合理且有效的CFs，并在标签稀缺场景下，通过数据增强将分类器性能平均恢复20%的F1分数。与传统的优化方法相比，LLMs生成了更具临床可操作性和模型无关的反事实。
AI.keywords: 反事实解释, 大型语言模型, 健康干预, 数据增强, 传感器数据
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLMs）的强大生成能力应用于传统的反事实解释（CFE）领域，特别是通过微调使其适应临床健康数据（项目名称为SenseCF）。其重要性在于，它提供了一种灵活、模型无关、且能够生成语义连贯和临床可操作性更强的干预措施的方法，解决了传统CFE方法在生成结果可解释性和实用性方面的局限。此外，利用LLM生成的CFE作为增强数据，有效提高了模型在数据稀缺环境下的鲁棒性和预测性能，这对于处理不平衡或数据受限的数字健康数据集具有重要意义。

title: From Volumes to Slices: Computationally Efficient Contrastive Learning for Sequential Abdominal CT Analysis
summary: The requirement for expert annotations limits the effectiveness of deep learning for medical image analysis. Although 3D self-supervised methods like volume contrast learning (VoCo) are powerful and partially address the labeling scarcity issue, their high computational cost and memory consumption are barriers. We propose 2D-VoCo, an efficient adaptation of the VoCo framework for slice-level self-supervised pre-training that learns spatial-semantic features from unlabeled 2D CT slices via contrastive learning. The pre-trained CNN backbone is then integrated into a CNN-LSTM architecture to classify multi-organ injuries. In the RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma dataset, 2D-VoCo pre-training significantly improves mAP, precision, recall, and RSNA score over training from scratch. Our framework provides a practical method to reduce the dependency on labeled data and enhance model performance in clinical CT analysis. We release the code for reproducibility. https://github.com/tkz05/2D-VoCo-CT-Classifier

AI.title_translation: 从体素到切片：用于连续腹部CT分析的计算高效对比学习
AI.tldr: 提出2D-VoCo，将高成本的3D对比学习（VoCo）简化为高效的2D切片级预训练，用于腹部CT分析。它显著提高了在多器官损伤分类任务上的性能，减少了对标注数据的依赖。
AI.motivation: 专家标注的要求限制了深度学习在医学图像分析中的有效性。虽然3D自监督方法（如VoCo）很强大，但它们的计算成本和内存消耗很高，构成了障碍。
AI.method: 提出了2D-VoCo，一种高效的VoCo框架改编版，用于切片级自监督预训练。它通过对比学习从无标签的2D CT切片中学习空间语义特征。预训练的CNN骨干网络随后被集成到CNN-LSTM架构中，用于分类多器官损伤。
AI.result: 在RSNA 2023腹部创伤数据集上，2D-VoCo预训练比从头开始训练显著提高了mAP、精确度、召回率和RSNA分数。
AI.conclusion: 我们的框架提供了一种实用的方法，可以减少对标注数据的依赖，并提高模型在临床CT分析中的性能。
AI.translation: 专家标注的要求限制了深度学习在医学图像分析中的有效性。虽然像体素对比学习（VoCo）这样的3D自监督方法功能强大，并部分解决了标签稀缺的问题，但其高计算成本和内存消耗是障碍。我们提出了2D-VoCo，这是VoCo框架的一种高效改编版，用于切片级自监督预训练，通过对比学习从无标签的2D CT切片中学习空间语义特征。然后，预训练的CNN骨干网络被集成到一个CNN-LSTM架构中，用于分类多器官损伤。在RSNA 2023腹部创伤数据集上，2D-VoCo预训练比从头开始训练显著提高了mAP、精确度、召回率和RSNA分数。我们的框架提供了一种实用的方法，可以减少对标注数据的依赖，并提高模型在临床CT分析中的性能。我们发布了代码以供复现。https://github.com/tkz05/2D-VoCo-CT-Classifier
AI.summary: 针对3D自监督医学图像分析方法（如VoCo）计算成本高昂的问题，本文提出了2D-VoCo。这是一种高效的切片级自监督对比学习框架，用于从无标签的2D CT切片中提取空间语义特征。预训练的CNN骨干网络随后整合进CNN-LSTM架构进行多器官损伤分类。在RSNA 2023数据集上的实验表明，2D-VoCo预训练显著提升了模型性能指标，提供了一种实用的、减少标注依赖的临床CT分析方法。
AI.keywords: 对比学习, CT分析, 自监督学习, 计算效率, 序列分析
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了一个在实际医疗环境中部署强大的自监督模型（如3D VoCo）的关键瓶颈：计算资源限制。其创新之处在于有效地将体素对比学习的核心原理转化为计算成本更低的2D切片级方法（2D-VoCo），同时保持了显著的性能提升。将这个2D特征提取器集成到序列模型（CNN-LSTM）中，是一种巧妙地隐式处理3D上下文的方式，使得该方法对于用于创伤分析的大型序列CT数据集具有实用性和可扩展性。报告的标准指标的显著改进证实了其对于使用有限标注数据增强临床诊断工具的重要性。

title: LFS: Learnable Frame Selector for Event-Aware and Temporally Diverse Video Captioning
summary: Video captioning models convert frames into visual tokens and generate descriptions with large language models (LLMs). Since encoding all frames is prohibitively expensive, uniform sampling is the default choice, but it enforces equal temporal coverage while ignoring the uneven events distribution. This motivates a Learnable Frame Selector (LFS) that selects temporally diverse and event-relevant frames. LFS explicitly models temporal importance to balance temporal diversity and event relevance, and employs a stratified strategy to ensure temporal coverage while avoiding clustering. Crucially, LFS leverages caption feedback from frozen video-LLMs to learn frame selection that directly optimizes downstream caption quality. Additionally, we identify the gap between existing benchmark and human's cognition. Thus, we introduce ICH-CC built from carefully designed questions by annotators that reflect human-consistent understanding of video. Experiments indicate that LFS consistently improves detailed video captioning across two representative community benchmarks and ICH-CC, achieving up to 2.0% gains on VDC and over 4% gains on ICH-CC. Moreover, we observe that enhanced captions with LFS leads to improved performance on video question answering. Overall, LFS provides an effective and easy-to-integrate solution for detailed video captioning.

AI.title_translation: LFS：用于事件感知和时间多样性视频字幕生成的学习型帧选择器
AI.tldr: 针对视频字幕中均匀采样效率低且忽略事件的问题，本文提出了可学习帧选择器LFS。LFS通过平衡时间多样性和事件相关性来智能选择关键帧，并利用LLM反馈直接优化字幕质量。LFS在现有和新的基准（ICH-CC）上均取得了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 视频字幕模型编码所有帧成本过高，而默认的均匀采样虽然确保了时间覆盖，但却忽略了视频中事件分布不均的问题，导致关键事件信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出可学习帧选择器（LFS）。LFS显式建模时间重要性以平衡时间多样性和事件相关性，并采用分层策略确保时间覆盖并避免聚类。LFS利用来自冻结视频-LLM的字幕反馈来学习帧选择，直接优化下游字幕质量。此外，还引入了新基准ICH-CC以反映人类一致的视频理解。
AI.result: LFS持续改进了详细视频字幕生成，在两个社区基准和新引入的ICH-CC上均有提升。在VDC上实现高达2.0%的增益，在ICH-CC上实现超过4%的增益。此外，LFS增强的字幕还能提高视频问答的性能。
AI.conclusion: LFS为详细视频字幕生成提供了一种有效且易于集成的解决方案，能够持续提高字幕的质量，并间接提升视频问答等相关任务的性能。
AI.translation: 视频字幕模型将帧转换为视觉标记，并使用大型语言模型（LLM）生成描述。由于编码所有帧成本过高，均匀采样成为默认选择，但这强制了相等的时间覆盖，同时忽略了事件分布不均。这促使我们提出了一个可学习帧选择器（LFS），用于选择时间多样化且与事件相关的帧。LFS明确建模时间重要性，以平衡时间多样性和事件相关性，并采用分层策略来确保时间覆盖，同时避免聚类。至关重要的是，LFS利用来自冻结视频-LLM的字幕反馈来学习帧选择，直接优化下游字幕质量。此外，我们发现了现有基准与人类认知之间的差距。因此，我们引入了ICH-CC，该基准由标注者通过精心设计的问题构建，反映了与人类一致的视频理解。实验表明，LFS在两个代表性社区基准和ICH-CC上持续改进了详细视频字幕生成，在VDC上实现高达2.0%的增益，在ICH-CC上实现超过4%的增益。此外，我们观察到LFS增强的字幕能够提高视频问答的性能。总而言之，LFS为详细视频字幕生成提供了一种有效且易于集成的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种可学习帧选择器（LFS），用于解决视频字幕生成中均匀采样忽略视频事件分布不均的问题。LFS通过显式建模时间重要性和采用分层策略，平衡了时间多样性和事件相关性，并利用冻结视频-LLM的字幕反馈直接优化输出质量。为了更好地评估模型，作者还引入了反映人类一致理解的新基准ICH-CC。实验证明LFS在多个基准上显著提高了详细视频字幕生成的性能，并能间接提升视频问答的表现。
AI.keywords: 可学习帧选择器,视频字幕生成,时间多样性,事件相关性,大型语言模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了可学习帧选择器（LFS），解决了视频字幕生成中帧选择的核心问题：即如何打破传统均匀采样的限制，同时平衡时间多样性（覆盖全面）和事件相关性（聚焦关键事件）。通过利用冻结视频-LLM的字幕反馈来指导帧选择的学习过程，LFS实现了直接优化下游字幕质量的目标，这是一种高效且任务驱动的优化方法。此外，作者识别出现有基准与人类认知之间的差距，并引入了新的ICH-CC基准，这对于推动视频理解和字幕生成社区的评估标准具有重要意义。LFS作为一个易于集成的模块，展示了其在提升详细视频描述能力上的有效性。

title: IntelliSA: An Intelligent Static Analyzer for IaC Security Smell Detection Using Symbolic Rules and Neural Inference
summary: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) enables automated provisioning of large-scale cloud and on-premise environments, reducing the need for repetitive manual setup. However, this automation is a double-edged sword: a single misconfiguration in IaC scripts can propagate widely, leading to severe system downtime and security risks. Prior studies have shown that IaC scripts often contain security smells--bad coding patterns that may introduce vulnerabilities--and have proposed static analyzers based on symbolic rules to detect them. Yet, our preliminary analysis reveals that rule-based detection alone tends to over-approximate, producing excessive false positives and increasing the burden of manual inspection. In this paper, we present IntelliSA, an intelligent static analyzer for IaC security smell detection that integrates symbolic rules with neural inference. IntelliSA applies symbolic rules to over-approximate potential smells for broad coverage, then employs neural inference to filter false positives. While an LLM can effectively perform this filtering, reliance on LLM APIs introduces high cost and latency, raises data governance concerns, and limits reproducibility and offline deployment. To address the challenges, we adopt a knowledge distillation approach: an LLM teacher generates pseudo-labels to train a compact student model--over 500x smaller--that learns from the teacher's knowledge and efficiently classifies false positives. We evaluate IntelliSA against two static analyzers and three LLM baselines (Claude-4, Grok-4, and GPT-5) using a human-labeled dataset including 241 security smells across 11,814 lines of real-world IaC code. Experimental results show that IntelliSA achieves the highest F1 score (83%), outperforming baselines by 7-42%. Moreover, IntelliSA demonstrates the best cost-effectiveness, detecting 60% of security smells while inspecting less than 2% of the codebase.

AI.title_translation: IntelliSA：一种使用符号规则和神经推理进行 IaC 安全异味检测的智能静态分析器
AI.tldr: IntelliSA是一种智能静态分析器，它结合了符号规则和神经推理来高效检测IaC安全异味。它通过知识蒸馏训练了一个小型模型来替代大型语言模型（LLM），实现了高准确性（F1分数83%）和出色的成本效益。
AI.motivation: IaC中的单个错误配置可能广泛传播，导致系统停机和安全风险。现有的基于符号规则的静态分析器会过度近似，产生过多误报，增加了人工检查的负担。
AI.method: 提出IntelliSA，一种集成符号规则和神经推理的智能静态分析器。首先使用符号规则进行过度近似以实现广泛覆盖，然后使用神经推理过滤误报。为解决直接使用LLM的成本和延迟问题，采用知识蒸馏方法，由LLM教师生成伪标签来训练一个紧凑（小500倍以上）的学生模型进行高效分类。
AI.result: IntelliSA在人类标注的数据集上进行了评估，实现了最高的F1分数（83%），比基线高出7%到42%。它还展示了最佳的成本效益，在检查不到2%代码库的情况下，检测出了60%的安全异味。
AI.conclusion: IntelliSA是一种用于IaC安全异味检测的智能静态分析器，它成功地将符号规则与神经推理集成，通过知识蒸馏克服了直接使用LLM的挑战，实现了高准确性（F1分数83%）和最佳成本效益。
AI.translation: 基础设施即代码 (IaC) 实现了大规模云和本地环境的自动化配置，减少了重复的手动设置需求。然而，这种自动化是一把双刃剑：IaC脚本中的单个错误配置可能会广泛传播，导致严重的系统停机和安全风险。先前的研究表明，IaC脚本通常包含安全异味——可能引入漏洞的不良编码模式——并提出了基于符号规则的静态分析器来检测它们。然而，我们的初步分析显示，单独基于规则的检测倾向于过度近似，产生过多的误报，增加了人工检查的负担。在本文中，我们提出了 IntelliSA，一种用于 IaC 安全异味检测的智能静态分析器，它将符号规则与神经推理相结合。IntelliSA 应用符号规则对潜在异味进行过度近似以实现广泛覆盖，然后采用神经推理来过滤误报。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）可以有效地执行此过滤，但对 LLM API 的依赖会带来高成本和延迟，引发数据治理问题，并限制了可复现性和离线部署。为应对这些挑战，我们采用了知识蒸馏方法：LLM 教师生成伪标签来训练一个紧凑的学生模型——小了 500 多倍——该模型学习教师的知识并高效地对误报进行分类。我们使用一个包含 11,814 行真实世界 IaC 代码中 241 个安全异味的人工标注数据集，对 IntelliSA 与两种静态分析器和三种 LLM 基线（Claude-4、Grok-4 和 GPT-5）进行了评估。实验结果显示，IntelliSA 实现了最高的 F1 分数（83%），比基线高出 7% 到 42%。此外，IntelliSA 展示了最佳的成本效益，在检查不到 2% 代码库的情况下，检测出了 60% 的安全异味。
AI.summary: 本文提出了IntelliSA，一种结合符号规则和神经推理的智能静态分析器，用于解决现有IaC安全异味检测器误报率高的问题。IntelliSA首先利用符号规则进行广泛覆盖，随后使用通过知识蒸馏训练出的紧凑型神经模型来高效过滤误报，避免了直接依赖昂贵且有数据隐私风险的LLM。实验证明，IntelliSA的F1分数达到83%，显著优于现有静态分析器和LLM基线，并具有极高的成本效益。
AI.keywords: IaC, 静态分析器, 安全异味检测, 符号规则, 神经推理
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于有效地结合了传统的符号规则分析（用于广覆盖）和现代的神经推理（用于误报过滤）。特别值得称赞的是，它采用了知识蒸馏方法，将大型语言模型（LLM）的知识转移到一个小巧且高效的学生模型中。这一策略成功解决了直接依赖LLM API所带来的高成本、高延迟和数据治理问题，使该工具具有极高的实用性和可部署性。该工具对提升IaC代码的安全性和自动化检测效率具有重要意义。

title: Optimality of Staircase Mechanisms for Vector Queries under Differential Privacy
summary: We study the optimal design of additive mechanisms for vector-valued queries under $ε$-differential privacy (DP). Given only the sensitivity of a query and a norm-monotone cost function measuring utility loss, we ask which noise distribution minimizes expected cost among all additive $ε$-DP mechanisms. Using convex rearrangement theory, we show that this infinite-dimensional optimization problem admits a reduction to a one-dimensional compact and convex family of radially symmetric distributions whose extreme points are the staircase distributions. As a consequence, we prove that for any dimension, any norm, and any norm-monotone cost function, there exists an $ε$-DP staircase mechanism that is optimal among all additive mechanisms. This result resolves a conjecture of Geng, Kairouz, Oh, and Viswanath, and provides a geometric explanation for the emergence of staircase mechanisms as extremal solutions in differential privacy.

AI.title_translation: 差分隐私下向量查询的阶梯机制的最优性
AI.tldr: 研究了差分隐私（DP）下向量查询的最佳加性机制。利用凸重排理论，证明了对于任何维度、范数和成本函数，阶梯机制在所有加性机制中都是最优的，从而解决了一个现有猜想。
AI.motivation: 寻找在 $\epsilon$-差分隐私约束下，对于向量查询，哪种噪声分布能够最小化预期成本（效用损失）。
AI.method: 使用凸重排理论（Convex Rearrangement Theory）将无限维优化问题简化为一个一维紧凑凸族的径向对称分布问题，其极值点即为阶梯分布。
AI.result: 证明了对于任何维度、任何范数和任何范数单调成本函数，都存在一个 $\epsilon$-DP 阶梯机制，它在所有加性机制中是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 阶梯机制在差分隐私下的向量查询中具有最优性，解决了 Geng, Kairouz, Oh, and Viswanath 的一个猜想，并为阶梯机制作为极值解的出现提供了几何解释。
AI.translation: 我们研究了 $\epsilon$-差分隐私（DP）下向量值查询的加性机制的最佳设计。仅给定查询的敏感度和衡量效用损失的范数单调成本函数，我们询问在所有加性 $\epsilon$-DP 机制中，哪种噪声分布能使预期成本最小化。利用凸重排理论，我们证明了这个无限维优化问题可以简化为一个一维紧凑凸族的径向对称分布，其极值点即为阶梯分布。因此，我们证明了对于任何维度、任何范数和任何范数单调成本函数，都存在一个 $\epsilon$-DP 阶梯机制，它在所有加性机制中是最优的。这一结果解决了一个由 Geng, Kairouz, Oh, 和 Viswanath 提出的猜想，并为阶梯机制作为差分隐私中极值解的出现提供了几何解释。
AI.summary: 本文研究了差分隐私（DP）下向量查询的最佳加性机制设计。目标是确定在给定查询敏感度和范数单调成本函数的情况下，哪种噪声分布能最小化预期效用损失。通过应用凸重排理论，作者将无限维优化问题简化为一个一维的径向对称分布族。核心结论是，对于任意维度、范数和范数单调成本函数，阶梯机制在所有加性 $\epsilon$-DP 机制中都是最优的。该发现解决了现有文献中的一个猜想，并提供了阶梯机制作为极值解的几何解释。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, 阶梯机制, 向量查询, 最优性, 凸重排理论
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于利用凸重排理论这一强大的数学工具，将一个复杂的无限维优化问题简化为可管理的低维问题，从而严格证明了阶梯机制在差分隐私背景下的普适最优性。这一结果不仅解决了差分隐私机制设计领域的一个长期存在的猜想，而且为理解和设计高效、最优的隐私保护机制提供了坚实的理论基础和几何洞察。

title: HELIOS: Hierarchical Graph Abstraction for Structure-Aware LLM Decompilation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to binary decompilation, yet they still treat code as plain text and ignore the graphs that govern program control flow. This limitation often yields syntactically fragile and logically inconsistent output, especially for optimized binaries. This paper presents \textsc{HELIOS}, a framework that reframes LLM-based decompilation as a structured reasoning task. \textsc{HELIOS} summarizes a binary's control flow and function calls into a hierarchical text representation that spells out basic blocks, their successors, and high-level patterns such as loops and conditionals. This representation is supplied to a general-purpose LLM, along with raw decompiler output, optionally combined with a compiler-in-the-loop that returns error messages when the generated code fails to build.
  On HumanEval-Decompile for \texttt{x86\_64}, \textsc{HELIOS} raises average object file compilability from 45.0\% to 85.2\% for Gemini~2.0 and from 71.4\% to 89.6\% for GPT-4.1~Mini. With compiler feedback, compilability exceeds 94\% and functional correctness improves by up to 5.6 percentage points over text-only prompting. Across six architectures drawn from x86, ARM, and MIPS, \textsc{HELIOS} reduces the spread in functional correctness while keeping syntactic correctness consistently high, all without fine-tuning. These properties make \textsc{HELIOS} a practical building block for reverse engineering workflows in security settings where analysts need recompilable, semantically faithful code across diverse hardware targets.

AI.title_translation: HELIOS：用于结构感知型LLM反编译的层次图抽象
AI.tldr: HELIOS通过将二进制文件的控制流和函数调用抽象为层次化文本表示，克服了LLM在反编译中忽略程序图结构的限制。这显著提高了代码的可编译性和功能正确性，并在多种架构上表现出高一致性，使其成为实用的逆向工程构建模块。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM反编译方法将代码视为纯文本，忽略了控制流图等程序结构，导致生成的代码在处理优化后的二进制文件时，容易出现语法脆弱和逻辑不一致的问题。
AI.method: 提出了HELIOS框架，将LLM反编译重构为结构化推理任务。HELIOS将二进制文件的控制流和函数调用总结为层次化文本表示，该表示详细说明了基本块、它们的后继以及循环和条件等高级模式。该表示与原始反编译器输出一起提供给通用LLM，并可选地结合编译器在环（compiler-in-the-loop）机制，当生成的代码构建失败时，该机制会返回错误信息。
AI.result: 在HumanEval-Decompile for x86\_64上，HELIOS将Gemini 2.0的平均目标文件可编译性从45.0%提高到85.2%，将GPT-4.1 Mini从71.4%提高到89.6%。结合编译器反馈后，可编译性超过94%，功能正确性比纯文本提示提高了高达5.6个百分点。在x86、ARM和MIPS的六种架构上，HELIOS在保持高语法正确性的同时，减少了功能正确性的分散性，且无需微调。
AI.conclusion: HELIOS的特性使其成为逆向工程工作流程中实用的构建模块，特别是在安全环境中，分析人员需要在各种硬件目标上获得可重新编译且语义忠实的代码。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近已被应用于二进制反编译，但它们仍将代码视为纯文本，忽略了控制程序控制流的图结构。这种局限性通常会导致生成的输出在语法上脆弱且逻辑上不一致，对于优化后的二进制文件尤其如此。本文提出了\textsc{HELIOS}，这是一个将基于LLM的反编译重构为结构化推理任务的框架。\textsc{HELIOS}将二进制文件的控制流和函数调用总结为层次化文本表示，该表示详细描述了基本块、它们的后继以及诸如循环和条件等高级模式。该表示与原始反编译器输出一起提供给通用LLM，并可选地结合了编译器在环（compiler-in-the-loop）机制，当生成的代码构建失败时，该机制会返回错误信息。在针对x86\_64的HumanEval-Decompile上，\textsc{HELIOS}将Gemini~2.0的平均目标文件可编译性从45.0\%提高到85.2\%，并将GPT-4.1~Mini从71.4\%提高到89.6\%。结合编译器反馈后，可编译性超过94\%，功能正确性比纯文本提示提高了高达5.6个百分点。跨越x86、ARM和MIPS的六种架构，\textsc{HELIOS}在保持语法正确性始终很高的同时，减少了功能正确性的分散性，所有这些都无需进行微调。这些特性使\textsc{HELIOS}成为逆向工程工作流程中一个实用的构建模块，适用于分析人员需要在各种硬件目标上获得可重新编译、语义忠实代码的安全环境。
AI.summary: HELIOS是一种用于LLM反编译的框架，旨在解决现有LLM忽略程序控制流图结构的问题。它通过将二进制结构抽象为层次化文本表示，并将该结构信息提供给通用LLM，将反编译转化为结构化推理任务。HELIOS显著提高了反编译代码的可编译性（在x86\_64上可达94%以上）和功能正确性，并且在x86、ARM和MIPS等多种硬件架构上表现出强大的泛化能力和一致性，无需微调，使其适用于安全逆向工程。
AI.keywords: LLM反编译, 层次图抽象, 结构化推理, 控制流, 可编译性
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于认识到LLM在处理二进制反编译时的主要限制——缺乏对程序底层图结构的理解。通过设计一种“层次图抽象”的结构化文本表示（HELIOS），该框架有效地将复杂的程序控制流信息编码成LLM可以理解和推理的格式。此外，可选的“编译器在环”反馈机制进一步提高了结果的可靠性和实用性，特别是大幅提升了代码的可编译性，解决了反编译代码在实际应用中经常遇到的核心痛点。其跨架构的泛化能力（无需微调）证明了该方法在安全和逆向工程领域具有高度的实用价值。

title: Rethinking Reinforcement fine-tuning of LLMs: A Multi-armed Bandit Learning Perspective
summary: A large number of heuristics have been proposed to optimize the reinforcement fine-tuning of LLMs. However, inconsistent claims are made from time to time, making this area elusive. Reflecting on this situation, two fundamental questions still lack a clear understanding: 1) what is the role of each optimizing choice? 2) which ones are the bottlenecks? This paper aims to shed light on them, and it faces the challenge of several entangled confounding factors in the fine-tuning process. To tackle this challenge, we propose a bottom-up experiment pipeline. The bottom layer is composed of a minimalist configuration: one training data, one rollout per round and the reward directly serve as the learning signal without advantage function design. This minimalist configuration connects to multi-armed bandit learning with extremely large discrete action space, which offers theories to corroborate the experiment findings. The up procedure of the experiment pipeline expanding the minimalist configuration layer by layer, examining the role of each design choice. Experimental results on three LLMs and two reasoning datasets not only reveal new understanding of the design choice but also yield essential insights to shape the area.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考LLM的强化微调：一个多臂赌博机学习的视角
AI.tldr: 本文通过提出一个自下而上的实验流程，从多臂赌博机学习的角度，系统地分析了LLM强化微调中各种优化选择的作用和瓶颈，以解决现有启发式方法中的混乱和不一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM的强化微调中存在大量启发式方法，但由于结论不一致，该领域仍不明确。作者旨在回答两个基本问题：1）每种优化选择的作用是什么？2）哪些是瓶颈？
AI.method: 提出了一种自下而上的实验流程来解决混杂因素的纠缠问题。底层是一个极简配置（单训练数据、每轮单次rollout、奖励直接作为学习信号，无优势函数），该配置与多臂赌博机学习（MAB）理论相联系。通过逐层扩展该配置，系统地检查每种设计选择的作用。
AI.result: 在三种LLM和两个推理数据集上的实验结果不仅揭示了对设计选择的新理解，而且提供了塑造该领域的重要见解。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及明确的结论，但指出研究结果揭示了对设计选择的新理解，并为塑造该领域提供了重要见解。
AI.translation: 已经提出了大量的启发式方法来优化LLM的强化微调。然而，不一致的说法时有出现，使得这一领域难以捉摸。反思这种情况，两个基本问题仍然缺乏清晰的理解：1）每种优化选择的作用是什么？2）哪些是瓶颈？本文旨在阐明这些问题，并应对微调过程中几个相互纠缠的混杂因素的挑战。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种自下而上的实验流程。底层由一个极简配置组成：一个训练数据、每轮一次rollout，奖励直接作为学习信号，没有优势函数设计。这种极简配置与具有极大离散动作空间的多臂赌博机学习相联系，后者提供了理论来证实实验发现。实验流程的向上过程逐层扩展极简配置，检验每种设计选择的作用。在三种LLM和两个推理数据集上的实验结果不仅揭示了对设计选择的新理解，而且为塑造该领域提供了重要见键。
AI.summary: 针对LLM强化微调中优化选择的混乱现状，本文提出了一种系统的自下而上实验流程。研究首先采用一个与多臂赌博机学习相对应的极简配置，然后逐层扩展，系统地分析了不同设计选择的作用和瓶颈。在三种LLM和两个推理数据集上的实验结果提供了对该领域至关重要的全新见解。
AI.keywords: 强化微调, LLM, 多臂赌博机学习, 自下而上实验流程, 设计选择
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将复杂的LLM强化微调过程与具有扎实理论基础的多臂赌博机（MAB）学习框架联系起来。通过提出自下而上的实验流程，该研究旨在系统地解构RLHF中相互纠缠的混杂因素，从而解决现有启发式方法中的不一致性问题。这种系统性的方法对于提高LLM微调领域的透明度和科学严谨性具有重要意义。

title: Holmes: An Evidence-Grounded LLM Agent for Auditable DDoS Investigation in Cloud Networks
summary:
Cloud environments face frequent DDoS threats due to centralized resources and broad attack surfaces. Modern cloud-native DDoS attacks further evolve rapidly and often blend multi-vector strategies, creating an operational dilemma: defenders need wire-speed monitoring while also requiring explainable, auditable attribution for response. Existing rule-based and supervised-learning approaches typically output black-box scores or labels, provide limited evidence chains, and generalize poorly to unseen attack variants; meanwhile, high-quality labeled data is often difficult to obtain in cloud settings.
  We present Holmes (DDoS Detective), an LLM-based DDoS detection agent that reframes the model as a virtual SRE investigator rather than an end-to-end classifier. Holmes couples a funnel-like hierarchical workflow (counters/sFlow for continuous sensing and triage; PCAP evidence collection triggered only on anomaly windows) with an Evidence Pack abstraction that converts binary packets into compact, reproducible, high-signal structured evidence. On top of this evidence interface, Holmes enforces a structure-first investigation protocol and strict JSON/quotation constraints to produce machine-consumable reports with auditable evidence anchors.
  We evaluate Holmes on CICDDoS2019 reflection/amplification attacks and script-triggered flooding scenarios. Results show that Holmes produces attribution decisions grounded in salient evidence anchors across diverse attack families, and when errors occur, its audit logs make the failure source easy to localize, demonstrating the practicality of an LLM agent for cost-controlled and traceable DDoS investigation in cloud operations.

AI.title_translation: Holmes：一个用于云网络中可审计DDoS调查的证据驱动型LLM代理
AI.tldr: 针对云网络中快速变化的DDoS攻击，本文提出了Holmes，一个基于LLM的侦探代理，它使用分层工作流和结构化证据包来生成可审计、可追溯的DDoS归因报告，解决了现有黑箱方法的归因和可解释性问题。
AI.motivation: 云环境面临频繁且快速演变的多向量DDoS威胁。防御者需要线速监控，同时也需要可解释、可审计的归因。现有的基于规则或监督学习的方法是黑箱，缺乏证据链，泛化性差，且高质量的标注数据难以获取。
AI.method: 提出了Holmes（DDoS侦探），一个基于LLM的DDoS检测代理，将其视为虚拟SRE调查员而非分类器。方法包括：1. 漏斗式分层工作流：使用计数器/sFlow进行持续感知和分诊，仅在异常窗口触发PCAP证据收集。2. 证据包抽象：将二进制数据包转换为紧凑、可复现、高信号的结构化证据。3. 结构优先调查协议：在证据接口之上，强制执行严格的JSON/引用约束，以生成带有可审计证据锚点的机器可消费报告。
AI.result: 在CICDDoS2019反射/放大攻击和脚本触发的泛洪场景中进行了评估。结果显示，Holmes能够根据显著的证据锚点在不同攻击族中生成归因决策。当发生错误时，其审计日志可以轻松定位故障源，证明了LLM代理在云操作中进行成本控制和可追溯DDoS调查的实用性。
AI.translation: 由于资源集中和攻击面广，云环境面临频繁的DDoS威胁。现代云原生DDoS攻击发展迅速，通常混合多向量策略，造成了操作上的困境：防御者既需要线速监控，又需要可解释、可审计的归因来进行响应。现有的基于规则和监督学习的方法通常输出黑箱分数或标签，提供的证据链有限，并且对未见的攻击变体泛化能力差；同时，在云环境中通常难以获得高质量的标注数据。我们提出了Holmes（DDoS侦探），一个基于LLM的DDoS检测代理，它将模型重构为虚拟SRE调查员，而非端到端分类器。Holmes结合了一种漏斗式分层工作流（计数器/sFlow用于持续感知和分诊；仅在异常窗口触发PCAP证据收集）以及一种证据包抽象，将二进制数据包转换为紧凑、可复现、高信号的结构化证据。在这个证据接口之上，Holmes强制执行结构优先的调查协议和严格的JSON/引用约束，以生成带有可审计证据锚点的机器可消费报告。我们在CICDDoS2019反射/放大攻击和脚本触发的泛洪场景中评估了Holmes。结果显示，Holmes在不同的攻击族中生成了基于显著证据锚点的归因决策，并且当发生错误时，其审计日志使得故障源易于定位，证明了LLM代理在云操作中进行成本控制和可追溯DDoS调查的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Holmes，一个证据驱动的LLM代理，用于云网络中的DDoS调查。针对传统黑箱方法缺乏可解释性和泛化能力的问题，Holmes将LLM代理设计为虚拟调查员，采用分层监控工作流和“证据包”抽象将原始数据包转化为结构化证据。该系统通过强制结构化报告和证据锚点，实现了对DDoS归因的可审计和可追溯性，实验证明了其在多种攻击场景下的实用性。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, DDoS调查, 可审计归因, 云网络, 证据驱动
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）从传统的端到端分类器角色，转化为一个具有人类调查逻辑的“虚拟SRE调查员”。这种范式转变直接解决了网络安全领域长期存在的黑箱问题和归因困难。通过引入“证据包”抽象和结构优先的调查协议，论文有效地将非结构化的网络流量数据转化为可审计、机器可消费的结构化报告，极大地提高了DDoS响应的透明度和可信度。此外，强调成本控制（仅在异常时收集PCAP）和错误定位（审计日志）显示了该系统具备高度的实际操作价值。

title: 3D Space as a Scratchpad for Editable Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has shown that reasoning improves when intermediate thoughts are externalized into explicit workspaces, such as chain-of-thought traces or tool-augmented reasoning. Yet, visual language models (VLMs) lack an analogous mechanism for spatial reasoning, limiting their ability to generate images that accurately reflect geometric relations, object identities, and compositional intent. We introduce the concept of a spatial scratchpad -- a 3D reasoning substrate that bridges linguistic intent and image synthesis. Given a text prompt, our framework parses subjects and background elements, instantiates them as editable 3D meshes, and employs agentic scene planning for placement, orientation, and viewpoint selection. The resulting 3D arrangement is rendered back into the image domain with identity-preserving cues, enabling the VLM to generate spatially consistent and visually coherent outputs. Unlike prior 2D layout-based methods, our approach supports intuitive 3D edits that propagate reliably into final images. Empirically, it achieves a 32% improvement in text alignment on GenAI-Bench, demonstrating the benefit of explicit 3D reasoning for precise, controllable image generation. Our results highlight a new paradigm for vision-language models that deliberate not only in language, but also in space. Code and visualizations at https://oindrilasaha.github.io/3DScratchpad/

AI.title_translation: 3D空间作为可编辑文本到图像生成的暂存器
AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型缺乏空间推理能力。本文提出了一个“3D空间暂存器”，将文本提示解析为可编辑的3D网格并进行代理场景规划，从而在生成前明确地规划场景布局。这使得图像生成具有空间一致性，并在GenAI-Bench上将文本对齐度提高了32%，同时支持可靠的3D编辑。
AI.motivation: 鉴于大型语言模型（LLMs）通过外部化中间思考提高了推理能力，但视觉语言模型（VLMs）缺乏空间推理的类似机制，这限制了它们生成准确反映几何关系、对象身份和构成意图的图像的能力。
AI.method: 引入“空间暂存器”（3D推理基质）。该框架首先解析文本提示，将主体和背景元素实例化为可编辑的3D网格。然后，使用“代理场景规划”进行放置、定向和视点选择。最后，将生成的3D布置通过身份保持线索渲染回图像域，以生成空间一致的图像。
AI.result: 在GenAI-Bench上的文本对齐度提高了32%。该方法能够生成空间一致且视觉连贯的输出，并支持可靠地传播到最终图像的直观3D编辑。
AI.conclusion: 明确的3D推理对精确、可控的图像生成有益。这突显了视觉-语言模型的一个新范式，即不仅在语言中，而且在空间中进行深思熟虑。
AI.translation: 最近大型语言模型（LLMs）的进展表明，当中间思考被外部化到明确的工作空间中时（例如思维链或工具增强推理），推理能力会得到提高。然而，视觉语言模型（VLMs）缺乏空间推理的类似机制，这限制了它们生成准确反映几何关系、对象身份和构成意图的图像的能力。我们引入了空间暂存器（spatial scratchpad）的概念——一个连接语言意图和图像合成的3D推理基质。给定一个文本提示，我们的框架会解析主体和背景元素，将它们实例化为可编辑的3D网格，并采用代理场景规划进行放置、定向和视点选择。由此产生的3D布置会通过身份保持线索渲染回图像域，使VLM能够生成空间一致且视觉连贯的输出。与先前基于2D布局的方法不同，我们的方法支持可靠地传播到最终图像的直观3D编辑。经验证明，它在GenAI-Bench上的文本对齐度提高了32%，展示了明确3D推理对于精确、可控图像生成的益处。我们的结果突显了视觉-语言模型的一个新范式，即不仅在语言上，而且在空间中进行深思熟虑。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）缺乏空间推理机制的问题，引入了“空间暂存器”——一个3D推理基质。该框架将文本提示转化为可编辑的3D网格，并利用代理场景规划来确定对象的位置和视角。通过将这种3D布置渲染回图像域，该方法能够生成空间一致且支持直观3D编辑的图像。实验结果显示，该方法在GenAI-Bench上的文本对齐度提高了32%，证明了明确的3D推理对于精确、可控图像生成的重要性。
AI.keywords: 3D空间, 文本到图像生成, 空间推理, 视觉语言模型, 暂存器
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将大型语言模型中成功的“暂存器”概念（如思维链）引入到视觉领域，通过使用明确的3D几何结构来解决视觉语言模型在空间和几何控制方面的核心限制。使用可编辑的3D网格作为中间表示，不仅保证了空间一致性，还实现了可靠的、可传播到最终图像的直观3D编辑，这超越了传统的2D布局方法，为精确、可控的图像生成提供了新的范式。

title: Variance-Adaptive Muon: Accelerating LLM Pretraining with NSR-Modulated and Variance-Scaled Momentum
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve competitive performance across diverse natural language processing (NLP) tasks, yet pretraining is computationally demanding, making optimizer efficiency an important practical consideration. Muon accelerates LLM pretraining via orthogonal momentum updates that serve as a matrix analogue of the element-wise sign operator. Motivated by the recent perspective that Adam is a variance-adaptive sign update algorithm, we propose two variants of Muon, Muon-NSR and Muon-VS, which apply variance-adaptive normalization to momentum before orthogonalization. Muon-NSR applies noise-to-signal ratio (NSR) modulation, while Muon-VS performs variance-based scaling without introducing additional hyperparameters. Experiments on GPT-2 and LLaMA pretraining demonstrate that our proposed methods accelerate convergence and consistently achieve lower validation loss than both competitive, well-tuned AdamW and Muon baselines. For example, on the LLaMA-1.2B model, Muon-NSR and Muon-VS reduce the iterations required to reach the target validation loss by $1.36\times$ relative to the well-tuned Muon following the recent benchmark.

AI.title_translation: 变异性自适应Muon：采用NSR调制和方差缩放动量加速LLM预训练
AI.tldr: 提出两种变异性自适应的Muon优化器（Muon-NSR和Muon-VS），通过在正交化前对动量应用方差自适应归一化，显著加速了GPT-2和LLaMA的预训练收敛速度，优于AdamW和标准Muon。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练的计算成本高昂，因此优化器效率至关重要。现有Muon优化器通过正交动量更新加速预训练，但作者受到Adam作为“方差自适应符号更新算法”的启发，旨在通过对Muon的动量进行方差自适应归一化来进一步提高其效率。
AI.method: 提出Muon-NSR和Muon-VS两种Muon变体，它们在执行正交化之前对动量应用方差自适应归一化。Muon-NSR采用信噪比（NSR）调制，而Muon-VS则执行基于方差的缩放，且无需引入额外的超参数。
AI.result: 在GPT-2和LLaMA预训练实验中，所提出的方法加速了收敛，并始终比精心调优的AdamW和标准Muon基线达到更低的验证损失。例如，在LLaMA-1.2B模型上，Muon-NSR和Muon-VS将达到目标验证损失所需的迭代次数减少了1.36倍。
AI.conclusion: 提出的变异性自适应Muon变体（Muon-NSR和Muon-VS）通过在正交化前应用方差自适应归一化，成功加速了LLM预训练的收敛，并始终优于竞争性的AdamW和标准Muon基线。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在各种自然语言处理（NLP）任务中取得了有竞争力的性能，但预训练需要大量的计算，使得优化器的效率成为一个重要的实际考量。Muon通过作为元素级符号算子的矩阵模拟的正交动量更新来加速LLM预训练。受最近将Adam视为方差自适应符号更新算法的观点的启发，我们提出了Muon的两种变体：Muon-NSR和Muon-VS，它们在正交化之前对动量应用方差自适应归一化。Muon-NSR应用信噪比（NSR）调制，而Muon-VS则执行基于方差的缩放，且无需引入额外的超参数。在GPT-2和LLaMA预训练上的实验表明，我们提出的方法加速了收敛，并且始终比具有竞争力的、精心调优的AdamW和Muon基线实现更低的验证损失。例如，在LLaMA-1.2B模型上，Muon-NSR和Muon-VS将达到目标验证损失所需的迭代次数减少了1.36倍（相对于遵循最新基准的精心调优的Muon）。
AI.summary: 本文旨在通过提高优化器效率来加速计算密集型的大语言模型（LLM）预训练。作者基于Adam是方差自适应符号更新算法的观点，提出了Muon优化器的两种变体：Muon-NSR和Muon-VS。这两种方法在动量正交化之前应用方差自适应归一化（分别采用信噪比调制或方差缩放）。实验证明，在GPT-2和LLaMA预训练任务中，Muon-NSR和Muon-VS显著加速了收敛速度，并持续实现比AdamW和标准Muon更低的验证损失，例如将LLaMA-1.2B模型的收敛迭代次数减少了1.36倍。
AI.keywords: LLM预训练, Muon, 优化器, 方差自适应, 动量
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将Adam优化器中的“方差自适应”思想成功地融入到Muon这种基于正交动量的优化器中。通过引入NSR调制和无额外超参数的方差缩放，作者有效地提高了LLM预训练的效率。在计算资源日益成为瓶颈的背景下，这种对优化器原理的深入理解和改进，对于降低大型模型训练成本和加速研究具有重要的实践价值。

title: U-Harmony: Enhancing Joint Training for Segmentation Models with Universal Harmonization
summary: In clinical practice, medical segmentation datasets are often limited and heterogeneous, with variations in modalities, protocols, and anatomical targets across institutions. Existing deep learning models struggle to jointly learn from such diverse data, often sacrificing either generalization or domain-specific knowledge. To overcome these challenges, we propose a joint training method called Universal Harmonization (U-Harmony), which can be integrated into deep learning-based architectures with a domain-gated head, enabling a single segmentation model to learn from heterogeneous datasets simultaneously. By integrating U-Harmony, our approach sequentially normalizes and then denormalizes feature distributions to mitigate domain-specific variations while preserving original dataset-specific knowledge. More appealingly, our framework also supports universal modality adaptation, allowing the seamless learning of new imaging modalities and anatomical classes. Extensive experiments on cross-institutional brain lesion datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new benchmark for robust and adaptable 3D medical image segmentation models in real-world clinical settings.

AI.title_translation: U-Harmony：利用通用协调增强分割模型的联合训练
AI.tldr: 针对医疗图像分割数据异构且有限的问题，提出U-Harmony联合训练方法。该方法通过特征分布的顺序归一化和反归一化，使单个分割模型能同时学习多样化数据，提高模型的鲁棒性和通用性。
AI.motivation: 医疗分割数据集通常有限且异构（模态、协议、解剖目标存在差异）。现有深度学习模型难以有效联合学习这些多样化数据，导致泛化能力或领域特定知识受损。
AI.method: 提出通用协调（U-Harmony）联合训练方法，可通过一个域门控头（domain-gated head）集成到深度学习架构中。该方法通过顺序地对特征分布进行归一化和反归一化，以减轻特定领域差异，同时保留原始数据集的特定知识。该框架还支持通用模态适应。
AI.result: 在跨机构脑损伤数据集上进行了广泛实验，证明了该方法的有效性，并为真实临床环境中的鲁棒且适应性强的3D医学图像分割模型建立了新的基准。
AI.conclusion: U-Harmony方法为在真实临床环境中构建鲁棒且适应性强的3D医学图像分割模型建立了一个新的基准。
AI.translation: 在临床实践中，医学分割数据集通常有限且异构，在不同机构间存在模态、协议和解剖目标上的差异。现有的深度学习模型难以联合学习此类多样化数据，通常会牺牲泛化能力或领域特定知识。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种称为通用协调（U-Harmony）的联合训练方法，该方法可以通过一个域门控头集成到基于深度学习的架构中，使单个分割模型能够同时学习异构数据集。通过集成U-Harmony，我们的方法顺序地对特征分布进行归一化和反归一化，以减轻特定领域差异，同时保留原始数据集的特定知识。更具吸引力的是，我们的框架还支持通用模态适应，允许无缝学习新的成像模态和解剖类别。在跨机构脑损伤数据集上进行的广泛实验证明了我们方法的有效性，为真实临床环境中的鲁棒且适应性强的3D医学图像分割模型建立了新的基准。
AI.summary: 本文针对医疗分割数据有限且异构的挑战，提出了U-Harmony联合训练方法。该方法通过域门控头集成到深度学习架构中，并顺序地对特征分布进行归一化和反归一化。这有效地减轻了领域差异，同时保留了关键的领域特定知识。U-Harmony还支持通用模态适应，并在跨机构脑损伤数据集上得到验证，为鲁棒且适应性强的3D医疗图像分割模型设定了新基准。
AI.keywords: 通用协调, 联合训练, 分割模型, 异构数据集, 模态适应
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“通用协调”（U-Harmony）机制，通过特征分布的顺序归一化和反归一化来主动管理领域差异，同时保留数据集的原始特定知识。这种方法允许单个模型在高度异构的医疗数据集上进行联合训练，显著提高了模型在真实临床环境中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。该方法支持通用模态适应的特性，对于解决医疗AI领域数据稀缺和多样性的核心挑战具有重要意义。

title: An LLM Agent-based Framework for Whaling Countermeasures
summary: With the spread of generative AI in recent years, attacks known as Whaling have become a serious threat. Whaling is a form of social engineering that targets important high-authority individuals within organizations and uses sophisticated fraudulent emails. In the context of Japanese universities, faculty members frequently hold positions that combine research leadership with authority within institutional workflows. This structural characteristic leads to the wide public disclosure of high-value information such as publications, grants, and detailed researcher profiles. Such extensive information exposure enables the construction of highly precise target profiles using generative AI. This raises concerns that Whaling attacks based on high-precision profiling by generative AI will become prevalent. In this study, we propose a Whaling countermeasure framework for university faculty members that constructs personalized defense profiles and uses large language model (LLM)-based agents. We design agents that (i) build vulnerability profiles for each target from publicly available information on faculty members, (ii) identify potential risk scenarios relevant to Whaling defense based on those profiles, (iii) construct defense profiles corresponding to the vulnerabilities and anticipated risks, and (iv) analyze Whaling emails using the defense profiles. Furthermore, we conduct a preliminary risk-assessment experiment. The results indicate that the proposed method can produce judgments accompanied by explanations of response policies that are consistent with the work context of faculty members who are Whaling targets. The findings also highlight practical challenges and considerations for future operational deployment and systematic evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于捕鲸（Whaling）反制的LLM代理框架
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个使用LLM代理的“捕鲸”攻击防御框架，专门针对信息高度公开的大学教职员工。该框架通过为每个教员建立“脆弱性画像”和“防御画像”，然后用这些画像来分析可疑邮件，初步实验证明该方法可以提供与教员工作环境相符的防御建议。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的普及使得“捕鲸”攻击（针对组织内高权限人员的复杂欺诈邮件）成为严重威胁。日本大学的教职员工因其研究领导和机构工作权限的结合，公开信息（如出版物、资助、详细研究者资料）广泛，这使得利用生成式AI构建高精度目标画像成为可能，从而加剧了基于高精度画像的捕鲸攻击的风险。
AI.method: 提出一个面向大学教职员工的捕鲸反制框架，该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）代理。具体设计了四个步骤的代理：(i) 从公开信息构建目标脆弱性画像；(ii) 识别与捕鲸防御相关的潜在风险场景；(iii) 依据脆弱性和预期风险构建防御画像；(iv) 使用防御画像分析捕鲸邮件。最后进行了初步的风险评估实验。
AI.result: 初步风险评估实验表明，所提出的方法可以产生与捕鲸目标教职员工工作情境一致的、带有响应策略解释的判断。
AI.conclusion: 初步风险评估实验表明，所提出的方法能够根据教职员工的工作背景，生成附带响应策略解释的判断，这与捕鲸目标教职员工的工作情境一致。研究结果也指出了未来实际部署和系统评估的实际挑战和注意事项。
AI.translation: 近年来，随着生成式AI的普及，被称为“捕鲸”的攻击已成为一种严重威胁。“捕鲸”是一种社会工程学形式，它以组织内重要的高权限个人为目标，并使用复杂的欺诈性电子邮件。在意大利大学的背景下，教职员工经常担任结合了研究领导权和机构工作流程权限的职位。这种结构特征导致了出版物、资助和详细研究者资料等高价值信息的广泛公开披露。这种广泛的信息暴露使得利用生成式AI构建高度精确的目标画像成为可能。这引发了人们的担忧，即基于生成式AI的高精度画像的“捕鲸”攻击将变得普遍。在本研究中，我们为大学教职员工提出了一种捕鲸反制框架，该框架构建个性化的防御画像并使用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理。我们设计的代理（i）根据教职员工的公开信息为每个目标构建脆弱性画像，（ii）根据这些画像识别与捕鲸防御相关的潜在风险场景，（iii）构建与脆弱性和预期风险相对应的防御画像，以及（iv）使用防御画像分析捕鲸邮件。此外，我们进行了一项初步的风险评估实验。结果表明，所提出的方法可以产生与捕鲸目标教职员工工作情境相一致的、带有响应策略解释的判断。研究结果也突出了未来实际部署和系统评估的实际挑战和注意事项。
AI.summary: 鉴于生成式AI助推的“捕鲸”攻击对高权限人员构成严重威胁，本研究针对大学教职员工提出了一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）代理的反制框架。该框架通过分析公开信息构建目标脆弱性画像，识别风险场景，并生成个性化的防御画像来分析捕鲸邮件，初步实验验证了该方法在提供情境化防御策略方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 捕鲸攻击,大型语言模型,代理框架,防御画像,社会工程学
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个基于LLM代理的框架来应对针对大学教职员工的“捕鲸”攻击，通过构建个性化的防御画像来提高防御的精准性。重要性在于它针对当前生成式AI带来的新型社会工程学威胁，提供了具体的、可操作的防御机制。局限性在于这只是一个初步的风险评估实验，其实际部署和系统性评估仍需未来工作。

title: Exploring Performance-Productivity Trade-offs in AMT Runtimes: A Task Bench Study of Itoyori, ItoyoriFBC, HPX, and MPI
summary:
Asynchronous Many-Task (AMT) runtimes offer a productive alternative to the Message Passing Interface (MPI). However, the diverse AMT landscape makes fair comparisons challenging. Task Bench, proposed by Slaughter et al., addresses this challenge through a parameterized framework for evaluating parallel programming systems. This work integrates two recent cluster AMTs, Itoyori and ItoyoriFBC, into Task Bench for comprehensive evaluation against MPI and HPX. Itoyori employs a Partitioned Global Address Space (PGAS) model with RDMA-based work stealing, while ItoyoriFBC extends it with futurebased synchronization.
  We evaluate these systems in terms of both performance and programmer productivity. Performance is assessed across various configurations, including compute-bound kernels, weak scaling, and both imbalanced and communication-intensive patterns. Performance is quantified using application efficiency, i.e., the percentage of maximum performance achieved, and the Minimum Effective Task Granularity (METG), i.e., the smallest task duration before runtime overheads dominate. Programmer productivity is quantified using Lines of Code (LOC) and the Number of Library Constructs (NLC).
  Our results reveal distinct trade-offs. MPI achieves the highest efficiency for regular, communication-light workloads but requires verbose, lowlevel code. HPX maintains stable efficiency under load imbalance across varying node counts, yet ranks last in productivity metrics, demonstrating that AMTs do not inherently guarantee improved productivity over MPI. Itoyori achieves the highest efficiency in communication-intensive configurations while leading in programmer productivity. ItoyoriFBC exhibits slightly lower efficiency than Itoyori, though its future-based synchronization offers potential for expressing irregular workloads.

AI.title_translation: 探索AMT运行时中的性能-生产力权衡：Itoyori、ItoyoriFBC、HPX和MPI的Task Bench研究
AI.tldr: 本文使用Task Bench框架评估了Itoyori、ItoyoriFBC、HPX和MPI这四种运行时环境在性能和程序员生产力方面的权衡，发现它们在不同工作负载下表现各异，且AMT并非总是比MPI更具生产力。
AI.motivation: 异步多任务（AMT）运行时为消息传递接口（MPI）提供了一种高效的替代方案，但AMT生态系统的多样性使得公平比较变得困难。本研究旨在通过一个参数化框架来解决这一挑战，从而对并行编程系统进行全面评估。
AI.method: 本研究将Itoyori和ItoyoriFBC这两个集群AMT运行时集成到Task Bench框架中，并与MPI和HPX进行综合评估。性能通过应用效率和最小有效任务粒度（METG）量化，而程序员生产力通过代码行数（LOC）和库构造数量（NLC）量化。评估涵盖计算密集型核、弱扩展性以及不平衡和通信密集型模式。
AI.result: MPI在常规、通信轻量级工作负载下实现最高效率，但需要冗长、低级的代码。HPX在负载不平衡时保持稳定效率，但在生产力指标上排名最后，表明AMT并非固有地保证比MPI更高的生产力。Itoyori在通信密集型配置中实现最高效率，并在程序员生产力方面领先。ItoyoriFBC的效率略低于Itoyori，但其基于未来的同步机制为表达不规则工作负载提供了潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了不同并行编程系统在性能和程序员生产力之间的独特权衡。Itoyori在通信密集型任务和生产力方面表现突出，而MPI在常规通信轻量级任务中效率最高但生产力低。AMT不一定比MPI提供更高的生产力。ItoyoriFBC的未来同步机制有潜力处理不规则工作负载。
AI.translation:
异步多任务（AMT）运行时为消息传递接口（MPI）提供了一种高效的替代方案。然而，AMT领域的多样性使得公平比较具有挑战性。由Slaughter等人提出的Task Bench通过一个参数化框架来评估并行编程系统，解决了这一挑战。这项工作将最近的两个集群AMT，Itoyori和ItoyoriFBC，集成到Task Bench中，以便与MPI和HPX进行全面评估。Itoyori采用基于RDMA工作窃取的PGAS（分区全局地址空间）模型，而ItoyoriFBC通过基于未来的同步机制对其进行了扩展。
我们从性能和程序员生产力两方面评估了这些系统。性能评估涵盖各种配置，包括计算密集型内核、弱扩展性以及不平衡和通信密集型模式。性能通过应用效率（即实现最大性能的百分比）和最小有效任务粒度（METG，即运行时开销占据主导地位之前的最小任务持续时间）进行量化。程序员生产力通过代码行数（LOC）和库构造数量（NLC）进行量化。
我们的结果揭示了明显的权衡。MPI在常规、通信轻量级工作负载下实现了最高效率，但需要冗长、低级的代码。HPX在不同节点数量下负载不平衡时保持稳定效率，但在生产力指标上排名最后，这表明AMT并不固有地保证比MPI更高的生产力。Itoyori在通信密集型配置中实现了最高效率，同时在程序员生产力方面领先。ItoyoriFBC的效率略低于Itoyori，但其基于未来的同步机制为表达不规则工作负载提供了潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究利用Task Bench框架，对四种并行运行时环境——Itoyori、ItoyoriFBC、HPX和MPI——的性能和程序员生产力进行了深入评估。通过衡量应用效率、最小有效任务粒度、代码行数和库构造数量，研究发现这些系统在不同工作负载下表现出独特的权衡。MPI在常规通信轻量任务中效率最高但生产力低；HPX在负载不平衡下效率稳定但生产力最差；Itoyori在通信密集型任务中效率最高且生产力领先；ItoyoriFBC的未来同步机制对不规则工作负载有潜力。研究强调AMT并非总是比MPI更具生产力。
AI.keywords: AMT运行时, 性能, 生产力, Task Bench, Itoyori
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入Itoyori和ItoyoriFBC到Task Bench框架，提供了一个对当前主流并行运行时环境进行系统性比较的宝贵视角。其创新之处在于同时量化了性能和程序员生产力，并揭示了两者之间的复杂权衡。特别重要的是，它挑战了“AMT固有地比MPI更具生产力”的普遍看法，为系统设计者和开发者在选择并行编程模型时提供了更细致的指导。未来工作可以进一步探索ItoyoriFBC在实际不规则工作负载中的表现。

title: Learning Consistent Taxonomic Classification through Hierarchical Reasoning
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding, they often fail to grasp hierarchical knowledge. This leads to common errors where VLMs misclassify coarser taxonomic levels even when correctly identifying the most specific level (leaf level). Existing approaches largely overlook this issue by failing to model hierarchical reasoning. To address this gap, we propose VL-Taxon, a two-stage, hierarchy-based reasoning framework designed to improve both leaf-level accuracy and hierarchical consistency in taxonomic classification. The first stage employs a top-down process to enhance leaf-level classification accuracy. The second stage then leverages this accurate leaf-level output to ensure consistency throughout the entire taxonomic hierarchy. Each stage is initially trained with supervised fine-tuning to instill taxonomy knowledge, followed by reinforcement learning to refine the model's reasoning and generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments reveal a remarkable result: our VL-Taxon framework, implemented on the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, outperforms its original 72B counterpart by over 10% in both leaf-level and hierarchical consistency accuracy on average on the iNaturalist-2021 dataset. Notably, this significant gain was achieved by fine-tuning on just a small subset of data, without relying on any examples generated by other VLMs.

AI.title_translation: 通过层次推理学习一致的分类学分类
AI.tldr: VL-Taxon是一个新的两阶段层次推理框架，用于解决视觉语言模型在分类学分类中常见的层次不一致错误，它通过结合监督学习和强化学习，在iNaturalist-2021上将准确率提高了10%以上。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽然擅长视觉理解，但在掌握层次知识方面存在不足，常出现即使能正确识别最具体的层级（叶级），但仍错误地对更粗的分类层级进行分类的问题。现有方法未能解决这种层次推理的缺失。
AI.method: VL-Taxon是一个两阶段、基于层次的推理框架。第一阶段采用自顶向下过程以提高叶级分类精度；第二阶段利用准确的叶级输出确保整个分类层次结构的一致性。每个阶段都首先使用监督微调来灌输分类学知识，随后通过强化学习来完善模型的推理和泛化能力。
AI.result: VL-Taxon框架（基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型）在iNaturalist-2021数据集上，平均在叶级和层次一致性准确率上均超越了其原始的72B模型超过10个百分点。值得注意的是，这一显著提升仅通过在少量数据集上进行微调而实现，且未依赖其他VLM生成的示例。
AI.conclusion: VL-Taxon框架通过两阶段的层次推理，成功提高了视觉语言模型在分类学分类中的叶级准确性和层次一致性，并在iNaturalist-2021数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 虽然视觉语言模型（VLMs）在视觉理解方面表现出色，但它们常常无法掌握层次知识。这导致了一个常见错误，即即使VLMs正确识别了最具体的层级（叶级），它们仍然会错误地对更粗的分类层级进行分类。现有方法大多忽略了这个问题，未能对层次推理进行建模。为解决这一差距，我们提出了VL-Taxon，一个旨在提高叶级准确性和分类学分类中层次一致性的两阶段、基于层次的推理框架。第一阶段采用自顶向下的过程以提高叶级分类精度。第二阶段则利用这一准确的叶级输出来确保整个分类层次结构的一致性。每个阶段都首先使用监督微调来灌输分类学知识，随后通过强化学习来完善模型的推理和泛化能力。广泛的实验揭示了一个惊人的结果：我们在Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型上实现的VL-Taxon框架，在iNaturalist-2021数据集上，平均在叶级和层次一致性准确率上均超越了其原始的72B模型超过10%。值得注意的是，这一显著的提升仅通过在少量数据子集上进行微调而实现，且没有依赖任何其他VLM生成的示例。
AI.summary: 针对视觉语言模型在分类学分类中缺乏层次一致性的问题，本文提出了VL-Taxon，一个两阶段的层次推理框架。该框架首先通过自顶向下过程提高叶级精度，然后确保整个分类树的一致性，并通过监督微调和强化学习进行训练。实验证明，VL-Taxon在iNaturalist-2021数据集上显著优于基线模型。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 分类学分类, 层次推理, 层次一致性, 顶向下过程
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个双阶段、基于层次的推理框架VL-Taxon，专门解决视觉语言模型在分类学分类中固有的层次一致性问题。其重要性在于显著提高了分类的准确性和层次结构的合理性。局限性是仅基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型进行评估，泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: Seeing to Think? How Source Transparency Design Shapes Interactive Information Seeking and Evaluation in Conversational AI
summary: Conversational AI systems increasingly function as primary interfaces for information seeking, yet how they present sources to support information evaluation remains under-explored. This paper investigates how source transparency design shapes interactive information seeking, trust, and critical engagement. We conducted a controlled between-subjects experiment (N=372) comparing four source presentation interfaces - Collapsible, Hover Card, Footer, and Aligned Sidebar - varying in visibility and accessibility. Using fine-grained behavioral analysis and automated critical thinking assessment, we found that interface design fundamentally alters exploration strategies and evidence integration. While the Hover Card interface facilitated seamless, on-demand verification during the task, the Aligned Sidebar uniquely mitigated the negative effects of information overload: as citation density increased, Sidebar users demonstrated significantly higher critical thinking and synthesis scores compared to other conditions. Our results highlight a trade-off between designs that support workflow fluency and those that enforce reflective verification, offering practical implications for designing adaptive and responsible conversational AI that fosters critical engagement with AI generated content.

AI.title_translation: 会思考的视觉化？来源透明度设计如何影响对话式人工智能中的交互式信息检索与评估
AI.tldr: 对话式AI中的来源呈现方式会影响用户的信息检索、信任和批判性参与。实验发现，悬停卡片界面方便即时验证，而对齐侧边栏界面则能有效缓解信息过载问题，提高用户批判性思维和信息综合能力。
AI.motivation: 对话式AI日益成为信息检索的主要接口，但其来源呈现方式如何支持信息评估的研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 通过一项包含372名参与者的对照组被试间实验，比较了四种来源呈现界面（可折叠、悬停卡片、页脚和对齐侧边栏），并进行了细致的行为分析和自动化批判性思维评估。
AI.result: 界面设计从根本上改变了信息探索策略和证据整合方式。悬停卡片界面方便用户在任务中即时验证信息，而对齐侧边栏界面在引用密度增加时，能显著提高用户的批判性思维和综合能力得分，有效缓解信息过载。
AI.conclusion: 界面设计在支持工作流程流畅性和强制反思性验证之间存在权衡。研究结果对设计能够促进用户批判性评估AI生成内容的自适应和负责任的对话式AI具有实际意义。
AI.translation: 对话式人工智能系统日益成为信息检索的主要接口，但它们如何呈现信息来源以支持信息评估的研究尚不充分。本研究探讨了来源透明度设计如何影响交互式信息检索、信任和批判性参与。我们进行了一项包含372名参与者的对照组被试间实验，比较了四种来源呈现界面——可折叠式、悬停卡片式、页脚式和对齐侧边栏式——它们在可见性和可访问性上有所不同。通过细致的行为分析和自动化批判性思维评估，我们发现界面设计从根本上改变了探索策略和证据整合。虽然悬停卡片界面能够在任务中实现无缝的按需验证，但对齐侧边栏界面独特地缓解了信息过载的负面影响：随着引用密度的增加，与其他条件相比，侧边栏用户表现出显著更高的批判性思维和综合能力得分。我们的研究结果强调了支持工作流程流畅性的设计与强制反思性验证的设计之间的权衡，为设计能够促进对AI生成内容进行批判性参与的自适应和负责任的对话式AI提供了实际启示。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了对话式人工智能中不同来源呈现界面的设计如何影响用户的信息检索、信任和批判性评估。通过实验对比了四种界面（可折叠、悬停卡片、页脚、对齐侧边栏），发现界面设计显著影响用户的探索策略和证据整合方式。悬停卡片界面便于即时验证，而对齐侧边栏界面在信息量大时能有效提升用户的批判性思维和信息综合能力。研究强调了在设计对话式AI时，需要在工作流程流畅性和强制反思性验证之间进行权衡，以促进用户对AI生成内容的批判性参与。
AI.keywords: 对话式AI,来源透明度,信息检索,批判性思维,界面设计
AI.comments: 这项研究很有价值，因为它解决了对话式AI日益增长的重要性以及随之而来的信息评估挑战。实验设计严谨，结合了行为分析和批判性思维评估，提供了有力的证据。研究结果揭示了界面设计在促进用户批判性参与方面的关键作用，并提出了实际的设计建议。然而，未来可以进一步探索不同用户群体对这些界面的偏好和适应性。

title: Exploiting Spot Instances for Time-Critical Cloud Workloads Using Optimal Randomized Strategies
comments: Accepted for publication in the 45th IEEE International Conference on Computer Communications (INFOCOM 2026). Copyright 2026 IEEE
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of deadline-aware online scheduling for jobs in hybrid cloud environments, where jobs may run on either cost-effective but unreliable spot instances or more expensive on-demand instances, under hard deadlines. We first establish a fundamental limit for existing (predominantly-) deterministic policies, proving a worst-case competitive ratio of $Ω(K)$, where $K$ is the cost ratio between on-demand and spot instances. We then present a novel randomized scheduling algorithm, ROSS, that achieves a provably optimal competitive ratio of $\sqrt{K}$ under reasonable deadlines, significantly improving upon existing approaches. Extensive evaluations on real-world trace data from Azure and AWS demonstrate that ROSS effectively balances cost optimization and deadline guarantees, consistently outperforming the state-of-the-art by up to $30\%$ in cost savings, across diverse spot market conditions.

AI.title_translation: 利用最优随机策略为时效性云工作负载利用现货实例
AI.tldr: 为了在成本敏感的现货实例和可靠的需求实例之间调度有时限的工作负载，研究人员证明了确定性算法效果很差 ($\Omega(K)$)，并提出了一个随机算法 ROSS，它在理论上是最优的 ($\sqrt{K}$)，并且在实际测试中比现有方法节省了高达 30% 的成本。
AI.motivation: 解决在混合云环境中，工作负载必须在成本效益高但不可靠的现货实例或更昂贵的需求实例上运行，同时必须满足硬性截止日期的挑战。
AI.method: 首先，证明了现有（主要是）确定性策略的最坏情况竞争比为 $\Omega(K)$。然后，提出了一个新颖的随机调度算法 ROSS，该算法在合理期限下实现了可证明的最优竞争比 $\sqrt{K}$。
AI.result: 证明了现有确定性策略的最坏情况竞争比为 $\Omega(K)$。提出了 ROSS 算法，实现了可证明的最优竞争比 $\sqrt{K}$。在 Azure 和 AWS 真实数据跟踪上，ROSS 算法在成本节约方面比现有最佳技术高出 30%。
AI.conclusion: ROSS算法在真实世界数据上表现出色，有效平衡了成本优化和截止日期保证，在成本节约方面优于现有技术达30%。
AI.translation: 本文解决了混合云环境中工作负载的截止日期感知在线调度的挑战，这些工作负载可能在成本效益高但不可靠的现货实例或更昂贵的需求实例上运行，同时必须满足硬性截止日期。我们首先为现有的（主要是）确定性策略建立了一个基本限制，证明了最坏情况的竞争比为 $\Omega(K)$，其中 $K$ 是按需实例和现货实例之间的成本比率。然后，我们提出了新颖的随机调度算法 ROSS，该算法在合理期限下实现了可证明的最优竞争比 $\sqrt{K}$，显著优于现有方法。在 Azure 和 AWS 的真实世界跟踪数据上的广泛评估表明，ROSS 有效地平衡了成本优化和截止日期保证，在各种现货市场条件下，成本节约比现有最佳技术高出 30%。
AI.summary: 本文针对混合云环境中具有硬性截止日期的工作负载的截止日期感知在线调度问题，证明了确定性策略存在 $\Omega(K)$ 的最坏情况竞争比。随后，提出了一种名为 ROSS 的新颖随机调度算法，该算法在合理期限内实现了理论上最优的 $\sqrt{K}$ 竞争比，并在实际云数据评估中显示出高达 30% 的成本节约。
AI.keywords: 现货实例, 混合云, 在线调度, 随机策略, 竞争比
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个具有理论最优竞争比的随机调度算法ROSS，解决了混合云环境中时效性工作负载的在线调度问题。其重要性在于为利用不可靠的现货实例提供了理论上最优的、实用的解决方案。局限性在于分析是基于“合理期限”的假设。

title: An Ion-Intercalation Memristor for Enabling Full Parallel Writing in Crossbar Networks
summary: Crossbar architectures have long been seen as a promising foundation for in-memory computing, using memristor arrays for high-density, energy-efficient analog computation. However, this conventional architecture suffers from a fundamental limitation: the inability to perform parallel write operations due to the sneak path problem. This arises from the structural overlap of read and write paths, forcing sequential or semi-parallel updates and severely limiting scalability. To address this, we introduce a new memristor design that decouples read and write operations at the device level. This design enables orthogonal conductive paths, and employs a reversible ion doping mechanism, inspired by lithium-ion battery principles, to modulate resistance states independently of computation. Fabricated devices exhibit near-ideal memristive characteristics and stable performance under isolated read/write conditions.

AI.title_translation: 用于实现交叉阵列中完全并行写入的离子插层忆阻器
AI.tldr: 为了解决交叉阵列中因通路问题导致的并行写入限制，研究人员设计了一种新型的离子插层忆阻器，它通过解耦读写路径和使用类锂电池的离子掺杂机制，实现了完全的并行写入能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的交叉阵列架构因“通路问题”（sneak path problem）而无法执行并行写入操作，这限制了其可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的忆阻器设计，该设计在器件层面解耦了读写操作，建立了正交导通路径，并采用受锂离子电池原理启发的、可逆的离子掺杂机制来独立于计算来调节电阻状态。
AI.result: 制造的器件表现出接近理想的忆阻特性，并在隔离的读/写条件下表现出稳定的性能。
AI.translation: 交叉阵列长期以来被视为内存计算的有前景的基础，利用忆阻器阵列实现高密度、高能效的模拟计算。然而，这种传统架构存在一个根本性的限制：由于通路问题，无法执行并行写入操作。这源于读写路径的结构重叠，迫使进行顺序或半并行更新，严重限制了可扩展性。为解决此问题，我们引入了一种新的忆阻器设计，它在器件层面解耦了读写操作。该设计实现了正交导通路径，并采用受锂离子电池原理启发的、可逆的离子掺杂机制，以独立于计算的方式调制电阻状态。制造的器件表现出接近理想的忆阻特性，并在隔离的读/写条件下表现出稳定的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型的离子插层忆阻器，通过在器件层面解耦读写操作并利用可逆的离子掺杂机制，克服了传统交叉阵列架构中因通路问题导致的并行写入限制，从而有望实现高密度、高能效的内存计算。
AI.keywords: 忆阻器, 交叉阵列, 内存计算, 离子插层, 并行写入
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于设计了一种新型离子插层忆阻器，成功解决了交叉阵列中因“通路问题”导致的写入操作无法完全并行化的问题，这对于提高内存计算的可扩展性至关重要。其方法借鉴了锂离子电池原理，实现了读写操作的解耦。

title: Towards Cybersecurity Superintelligence: from AI-guided humans to human-guided AI
summary:
Cybersecurity superintelligence -- artificial intelligence exceeding the best human capability in both speed and strategic reasoning -- represents the next frontier in security. This paper documents the emergence of such capability through three major contributions that have pioneered the field of AI Security. First, PentestGPT (2023) established LLM-guided penetration testing, achieving 228.6% improvement over baseline models through an architecture that externalizes security expertise into natural language guidance. Second, Cybersecurity AI (CAI, 2025) demonstrated automated expert-level performance, operating 3,600x faster than humans while reducing costs 156-fold, validated through #1 rankings at international competitions including the $50,000 Neurogrid CTF prize. Third, Generative Cut-the-Rope (G-CTR, 2026) introduces a neurosymbolic architecture embedding game-theoretic reasoning into LLM-based agents: symbolic equilibrium computation augments neural inference, doubling success rates while reducing behavioral variance 5.2x and achieving 2:1 advantage over non-strategic AI in Attack & Defense scenarios.
  Together, these advances establish a clear progression from AI-guided humans to human-guided game-theoretic cybersecurity superintelligence.

AI.title_translation: 迈向网络安全超智能：从人工智能指导的人类到人类指导的人工智能
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了网络安全领域的三项进展：PentestGPT（LLM指导的渗透测试）、Cybersecurity AI（CAI，自动化专家级性能）和Generative Cut-the-Rope（G-CTR，结合神经符号学和博弈论）。这些进展展示了从AI指导人类到人类指导博弈论网络安全超智能的清晰发展路径。
AI.motivation: 探索人工智能在网络安全领域超越人类能力，实现超智能的可能性。
AI.method: 论文介绍了三项关键技术：1. PentestGPT：通过自然语言指导实现LLM驱动的渗透测试。2. Cybersecurity AI（CAI）：实现自动化专家级网络安全性能。3. Generative Cut-the-Rope（G-CTR）：结合神经符号学和博弈论，为基于LLM的智能体嵌入博弈论推理。
AI.result: PentestGPT 实现了 228.6% 的性能提升。CAI 的运行速度比人类快 3,600 倍，成本降低 156 倍，并在国际竞赛中获得第一名。G-CTR 将成功率提高一倍，行为方差降低 5.2 倍，并在攻防场景中取得 2:1 的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了从AI指导人类到人类指导博弈论网络安全超智能的清晰发展路径，标志着网络安全领域AI能力的新前沿。
AI.translation: 网络安全超智能——在速度和战略推理方面都超越人类最佳能力的人工智能——代表着安全领域的新前沿。本文通过三项开创了人工智能安全领域先河的主要贡献，记录了这种能力的出现。首先，PentestGPT（2023）确立了LLM指导的渗透测试，通过将安全专业知识外部化为自然语言指导的架构，实现了比基线模型高出228.6%的改进。其次，网络安全人工智能（CAI，2025）展示了自动化的专家级性能，运行速度比人类快3,600倍，同时成本降低了156倍，并通过了包括50,000美元Neurogrid CTF奖在内的国际竞赛的排名第一的验证。第三，Generative Cut-the-Rope（G-CTR，2026）引入了一种神经符号学架构，将博弈论推理嵌入到基于LLM的智能体中：符号均衡计算增强了神经推理，使成功率加倍，同时行为方差降低了5.2倍，并在攻防场景中取得了2:1的优势，超越了非战略性AI。这些进展共同确立了从AI指导的人类到人类指导的博弈论网络安全超智能的清晰进展。
AI.summary: 本文概述了网络安全领域的三项关键进展，展示了人工智能在超越人类能力方面的潜力。PentestGPT通过LLM指导的渗透测试提高了效率；Cybersecurity AI实现了自动化专家级性能，速度更快、成本更低；G-CTR结合了神经符号学和博弈论，提高了AI智能体的战略推理能力。这些成果共同推动了网络安全领域从AI辅助人类走向人类指导AI的超智能发展。
AI.keywords: 网络安全超智能,人工智能安全,PentestGPT,Cybersecurity AI,Generative Cut-the-Rope
AI.comments: 该论文清晰地展示了网络安全领域人工智能发展的三个重要里程碑，并预示了未来AI与人类协作的新模式。通过结合LLM、自动化和神经符号学等先进技术，该研究为应对日益复杂的网络威胁提供了新的思路和工具。然而，关于“人类指导AI”的具体实现方式以及潜在的伦理和社会影响，还需要进一步的探讨。

title: SearchGym: Bootstrapping Real-World Search Agents via Cost-Effective and High-Fidelity Environment Simulation
summary: Search agents have emerged as a pivotal paradigm for solving open-ended, knowledge-intensive reasoning tasks. However, training these agents via Reinforcement Learning (RL) faces a critical dilemma: interacting with live commercial Web APIs is prohibitively expensive, while relying on static data snapshots often introduces noise due to data misalignment. This misalignment generates corrupted reward signals that destabilize training by penalizing correct reasoning or rewarding hallucination. To address this, we propose SearchGym, a simulation environment designed to bootstrap robust search agents. SearchGym employs a rigorous generative pipeline to construct a verifiable knowledge graph and an aligned document corpus, ensuring that every reasoning task is factually grounded and strictly solvable. Building on this controllable environment, we introduce SearchGym-RL, a curriculum learning methodology that progressively optimizes agent policies through purified feedback, evolving from basic interactions to complex, long-horizon planning. Extensive experiments across the Llama and Qwen families demonstrate strong Sim-to-Real generalization. Notably, our Qwen2.5-7B-Base model trained within SearchGym surpasses the web-enhanced ASearcher baseline across nine diverse benchmarks by an average relative margin of 10.6%. Our results validate that high-fidelity simulation serves as a scalable and highly cost-effective methodology for developing capable search agents.

title: UniCon: A Unified System for Efficient Robot Learning Transfers
summary: Deploying learning-based controllers across heterogeneous robots is challenging due to platform differences, inconsistent interfaces, and inefficient middleware. To address these issues, we present UniCon, a lightweight framework that standardizes states, control flow, and instrumentation across platforms. It decomposes workflows into execution graphs with reusable components, separating system states from control logic to enable plug-and-play deployment across various robot morphologies. Unlike traditional middleware, it prioritizes efficiency through batched, vectorized data flow, minimizing communication overhead and improving inference latency. This modular, data-oriented approach enables seamless sim-to-real transfer with minimal re-engineering. We demonstrate that UniCon reduces code redundancy when transferring workflows and achieves higher inference efficiency compared to ROS-based systems. Deployed on over 12 robot models from 7 manufacturers, it has been successfully integrated into ongoing research projects, proving its effectiveness in real-world scenarios.

title: Maximum Edge-based Quasi-Clique: Novel Iterative Frameworks
comments: Appears in the ACM Web Conference (WWW), 2026
summary: Extracting cohesive subgraphs from complex networks is a fundamental task in graph analytics and is essential for understanding biological, social, and web graphs. The edge-based $γ$-quasi-clique model offers a flexible alternative by identifying subgraphs whose edge densities exceed a specified threshold $γ$. However, finding the exact maximum edge-based quasi-clique is computationally challenging, as the problem is NP-hard and lacks the hereditary property. These characteristics limit the effectiveness of conventional pruning methods and the development of efficient reduction rules. As a result, existing algorithms, such as QClique and FPCE, struggle to scale to large graphs. In this paper, we revisit the problem and propose a novel iterative framework that reformulates the problem as a sequence of hereditary subproblems, enabling more effective pruning and reduction strategies and improving the worst-case time complexity. Furthermore, we redesign the iterative process and introduce a novel heuristic to further improve practical efficiency. Extensive experiments on 253 large-scale real-world graphs demonstrate that our proposed algorithm EQC-Pro outperforms existing methods by up to four orders of magnitude.

title: Direct and Converse Theorems in Estimating Signals with Sublinear Sparsity
comments: submitted to IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory
summary: This paper addresses the estimation of signals with sublinear sparsity sent over the additive white Gaussian noise channel. This fundamental problem arises in designing denoisers used in message-passing algorithms for sublinear sparsity. The main results are direct and converse theorems in the sublinear sparsity limit, where the signal sparsity grows sublinearly in the signal dimension as the signal dimension tends to infinity. As a direct theorem, the maximum likelihood estimator is proved to achieve vanishing square error in the sublinear sparsity limit if the noise variance is smaller than a threshold. As a converse theorem, all estimators cannot achieve square errors smaller than the signal power under a mild condition if the noise variance is larger than another threshold. In particular, the two thresholds coincide with each other when non-zero signals have constant amplitude. These results imply the asymptotic optimality of an existing separable Bayesian estimator used in approximate message-passing for sublinear sparsity.

title: Probing Prompt Design for Socially Compliant Robot Navigation with Vision Language Models
summary: Language models are increasingly used for social robot navigation, yet existing benchmarks largely overlook principled prompt design for socially compliant behavior. This limitation is particularly relevant in practice, as many systems rely on small vision language models (VLMs) for efficiency. Compared to large language models, small VLMs exhibit weaker decision-making capabilities, making effective prompt design critical for accurate navigation. Inspired by cognitive theories of human learning and motivation, we study prompt design along two dimensions: system guidance (action-focused, reasoning-oriented, and perception-reasoning prompts) and motivational framing, where models compete against humans, other AI systems, or their past selves. Experiments on two socially compliant navigation datasets reveal three key findings. First, for non-finetuned GPT-4o, competition against humans achieves the best performance, while competition against other AI systems performs worst. For finetuned models, competition against the model's past self yields the strongest results, followed by competition against humans, with performance further influenced by coupling effects among prompt design, model choice, and dataset characteristics. Second, inappropriate system prompt design can significantly degrade performance, even compared to direct finetuning. Third, while direct finetuning substantially improves semantic-level metrics such as perception, prediction, and reasoning, it yields limited gains in action accuracy. In contrast, our system prompts produce a disproportionately larger improvement in action accuracy, indicating that the proposed prompt design primarily acts as a decision-level constraint rather than a representational enhancement.

title: Break-Resilient Codes with Loss Tolerance
summary: Emerging applications in manufacturing, wireless communication, and molecular data storage require robust coding schemes that remain effective under physical distortions where codewords may be arbitrarily fragmented and partially missing. To address such challenges, we propose a new family of error-correcting codes, termed $(t,s)$-break-resilient codes ($(t,s)$-BRCs). A $(t,s)$-BRC guarantees correct decoding of the original message even after up to~$t$ arbitrary breaks of the codeword and the complete loss of some fragments whose total length is at most~$s$. This model unifies and generalizes previous approaches, extending break-resilient codes (which handle arbitrary fragmentation without fragment loss) and deletion codes (which correct bit losses in unknown positions without fragmentation) into a single information-theoretic framework. We develop a theoretical foundation for $(t,s)$-BRCs, including a formal adversarial channel model, lower bounds on the necessary redundancy, and explicit code constructions that approach these bounds.

title: Diffusion Epistemic Uncertainty with Asymmetric Learning for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection
summary: The rapid progress of diffusion models highlights the growing need for detecting generated images. Previous research demonstrates that incorporating diffusion-based measurements, such as reconstruction error, can enhance the generalizability of detectors. However, ignoring the differing impacts of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty on reconstruction error can undermine detection performance. Aleatoric uncertainty, arising from inherent data noise, creates ambiguity that impedes accurate detection of generated images. As it reflects random variations within the data (e.g., noise in natural textures), it does not help distinguish generated images. In contrast, epistemic uncertainty, which represents the model's lack of knowledge about unfamiliar patterns, supports detection. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, Diffusion Epistemic Uncertainty with Asymmetric Learning~(DEUA), for detecting diffusion-generated images. We introduce Diffusion Epistemic Uncertainty~(DEU) estimation via the Laplace approximation to assess the proximity of data to the manifold of diffusion-generated samples. Additionally, an asymmetric loss function is introduced to train a balanced classifier with larger margins, further enhancing generalizability. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks validate the state-of-the-art performance of our method.

title: A Brain-inspired Embodied Intelligence for Fluid and Fast Reflexive Robotics Control
summary: Recent advances in embodied intelligence have leveraged massive scaling of data and model parameters to master natural-language command following and multi-task control. In contrast, biological systems demonstrate an innate ability to acquire skills rapidly from sparse experience. Crucially, current robotic policies struggle to replicate the dynamic stability, reflexive responsiveness, and temporal memory inherent in biological motion. Here we present Neuromorphic Vision-Language-Action (NeuroVLA), a framework that mimics the structural organization of the bio-nervous system between the cortex, cerebellum, and spinal cord. We adopt a system-level bio-inspired design: a high-level model plans goals, an adaptive cerebellum module stabilizes motion using high-frequency sensors feedback, and a bio-inspired spinal layer executes lightning-fast actions generation. NeuroVLA represents the first deployment of a neuromorphic VLA on physical robotics, achieving state-of-the-art performance. We observe the emergence of biological motor characteristics without additional data or special guidance: it stops the shaking in robotic arms, saves significant energy(only 0.4w on Neuromorphic Processor), shows temporal memory ability and triggers safety reflexes in less than 20 milliseconds.

title: Relational Graph Modeling for Credit Default Prediction: Heterogeneous GNNs and Hybrid Ensemble Learning
summary:
Credit default risk arises from complex interactions among borrowers, financial institutions, and transaction-level behaviors. While strong tabular models remain highly competitive in credit scoring, they may fail to explicitly capture cross-entity dependencies embedded in multi-table financial histories. In this work, we construct a massive-scale heterogeneous graph containing over 31 million nodes and more than 50 million edges, integrating borrower attributes with granular transaction-level entities such as installment payments, POS cash balances, and credit card histories.
  We evaluate heterogeneous graph neural networks (GNNs), including heterogeneous GraphSAGE and a relation-aware attentive heterogeneous GNN, against strong tabular baselines. We find that standalone GNNs provide limited lift over a competitive gradient-boosted tree baseline, while a hybrid ensemble that augments tabular features with GNN-derived customer embeddings achieves the best overall performance, improving both ROC-AUC and PR-AUC. We further observe that contrastive pretraining can improve optimization stability but yields limited downstream gains under generic graph augmentations. Finally, we conduct structured explainability and fairness analyses to characterize how relational signals affect subgroup behavior and screening-oriented outcomes.

title: Landing-Induced Viscoelastic Changes in an Anthropomimetic Foot Joint Structure are Modulated by Foot Structure and Posture
summary: Cadaveric studies have provided important insights into the mechanics of the human foot arch and plantar fascia. However, repeatedly probing posture-dependent viscoelastic responses immediately after landing impact is difficult in biological specimens, leaving the contribution of skeletal architecture to landing dynamics incompletely understood. In this study, we developed an anthropomimetic foot joint structure aimed at replicating the skeletal geometry of the human foot. Using a vertical drop apparatus that simulates landing and a viscoelastic system-identification model, we investigated how skeletal structure and posture modulate the apparent post-impact viscoelastic response. The results show that the multi-jointed anthropomimetic structure exhibited a higher damping ratio than simplified flat and rigid feet. Moreover, ankle dorsiflexion and toe extension systematically shifted the identified parameters, reducing the damping ratio under the tested conditions. Taken together, these findings indicate that an arch-like, multi-jointed skeletal architecture can enhance impact attenuation in an anthropomimetic mechanical foot, and that morphology and passive posture alone can tune the trade-off between attenuation and rebound. The observed posture-dependent trends are qualitatively consistent with reported differences in human landing strategies, suggesting that skeletal architecture may partly account for the modulation. Furthermore, these results highlight the engineering advantage of anatomically informed skeletal replication for achieving human-like apparent viscoelastic behavior through postural adjustment during landing.

title: Forest-Chat: Adapting Vision-Language Agents for Interactive Forest Change Analysis
comments: 22 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, Submitted to Ecological Informatics
summary: The increasing availability of high-resolution satellite imagery, together with advances in deep learning, creates new opportunities for enhancing forest monitoring workflows. Two central challenges in this domain are pixel-level change detection and semantic change interpretation, particularly for complex forest dynamics. While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted for data exploration, their integration with vision-language models (VLMs) for remote sensing image change interpretation (RSICI) remains underexplored, especially beyond urban environments. We introduce Forest-Chat, an LLM-driven agent designed for integrated forest change analysis. The proposed framework enables natural language querying and supports multiple RSICI tasks, including change detection, change captioning, object counting, deforestation percentage estimation, and change reasoning. Forest-Chat builds upon a multi-level change interpretation (MCI) vision-language backbone with LLM-based orchestration, and incorporates zero-shot change detection via a foundation change detection model together with an interactive point-prompt interface to support fine-grained user guidance. To facilitate adaptation and evaluation in forest environments, we introduce the Forest-Change dataset, comprising bi-temporal satellite imagery, pixel-level change masks, and multi-granularity semantic change captions generated through a combination of human annotation and rule-based methods. Experimental results demonstrate that Forest-Chat achieves strong performance on Forest-Change and on LEVIR-MCI-Trees, a tree-focused subset of LEVIR-MCI, for joint change detection and captioning, highlighting the potential of interactive, LLM-driven RSICI systems to improve accessibility, interpretability, and analytical efficiency in forest change analysis.
