title: TIDAL: Temporally Interleaved Diffusion and Action Loop for High-Frequency VLA Control
summary: Large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer semantic generalization but suffer from high inference latency, limiting them to low-frequency batch-and-execute paradigm. This frequency mismatch creates an execution blind spot, causing failures in dynamic environments where targets move during the open-loop execution window. We propose TIDAL (Temporally Interleaved Diffusion and Action Loop), a hierarchical framework that decouples semantic reasoning from high-frequency actuation. TIDAL operates as a backbone-agnostic module for diffusion-based VLAs, using a dual-frequency architecture to redistribute the computational budget. Specifically, a low-frequency macro-intent loop caches semantic embeddings, while a high-frequency micro-control loop interleaves single-step flow integration with execution. This design enables approximately 9 Hz control updates on edge hardware (vs. approximately 2.4 Hz baselines) without increasing marginal overhead. To handle the resulting latency shift, we introduce a temporally misaligned training strategy where the policy learns predictive compensation using stale semantic intent alongside real-time proprioception. Additionally, we address the insensitivity of static vision encoders to velocity by incorporating a differential motion predictor. TIDAL is architectural, making it orthogonal to system-level optimizations. Experiments show a 2x performance gain over open-loop baselines in dynamic interception tasks. Despite a marginal regression in static success rates, our approach yields a 4x increase in feedback frequency and extends the effective horizon of semantic embeddings beyond the native action chunk size. Under non-paused inference protocols, TIDAL remains robust where standard baselines fail due to latency.

title: What Should I Cite? A RAG Benchmark for Academic Citation Prediction
summary: With the rapid growth of Web-based academic publications, more and more papers are being published annually, making it increasingly difficult to find relevant prior work. Citation prediction aims to automatically suggest appropriate references, helping scholars navigate the expanding scientific literature. Here we present \textbf{CiteRAG}, the first comprehensive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-integrated benchmark for evaluating large language models on academic citation prediction, featuring a multi-level retrieval strategy, specialized retrievers, and generators. Our benchmark makes four core contributions: (1) We establish two instances of the citation prediction task with different granularity. Task 1 focuses on coarse-grained list-specific citation prediction, while Task 2 targets fine-grained position-specific citation prediction. To enhance these two tasks, we build a dataset containing 7,267 instances for Task 1 and 8,541 instances for Task 2, enabling comprehensive evaluation of both retrieval and generation. (2) We construct a three-level large-scale corpus with 554k papers spanning many major subfields, using an incremental pipeline. (3) We propose a multi-level hybrid RAG approach for citation prediction, fine-tuning embedding models with contrastive learning to capture complex citation relationships, paired with specialized generation models. (4) We conduct extensive experiments across state-of-the-art language models, including closed-source APIs, open-source models, and our fine-tuned generators, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework. Our open-source toolkit enables reproducible evaluation and focuses on academic literature, providing the first comprehensive evaluation framework for citation prediction and serving as a methodological template for other scientific domains. Our source code and data are released at https://github.com/LQgdwind/CiteRAG.

title: Erosion Attack for Adversarial Training to Enhance Semantic Segmentation Robustness
summary: Existing segmentation models exhibit significant vulnerability to adversarial attacks.To improve robustness, adversarial training incorporates adversarial examples into model training. However, existing attack methods consider only global semantic information and ignore contextual semantic relationships within the samples, limiting the effectiveness of adversarial training. To address this issue, we propose EroSeg-AT, a vulnerability-aware adversarial training framework that leverages EroSeg to generate adversarial examples. EroSeg first selects sensitive pixels based on pixel-level confidence and then progressively propagates perturbations to higher-confidence pixels, effectively disrupting the semantic consistency of the samples. Experimental results show that, compared to existing methods, our approach significantly improves attack effectiveness and enhances model robustness under adversarial training.

title: TempViz: On the Evaluation of Temporal Knowledge in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Time alters the visual appearance of entities in our world, like objects, places, and animals. Thus, for accurately generating contextually-relevant images, knowledge and reasoning about time can be crucial (e.g., for generating a landscape in spring vs. in winter). Yet, although substantial work exists on understanding and improving temporal knowledge in natural language processing, research on how temporal phenomena appear and are handled in text-to-image (T2I) models remains scarce. We address this gap with TempViz, the first data set to holistically evaluate temporal knowledge in image generation, consisting of 7.9k prompts and more than 600 reference images. Using TempViz, we study the capabilities of five T2I models across five temporal knowledge categories. Human evaluation shows that temporal competence is generally weak, with no model exceeding 75% accuracy across categories. Towards larger-scale studies, we also examine automated evaluation methods, comparing several established approaches against human judgments. However, none of these approaches provides a reliable assessment of temporal cues - further indicating the pressing need for future research on temporal knowledge in T2I.

title: CorpusQA: A 10 Million Token Benchmark for Corpus-Level Analysis and Reasoning
summary: While large language models now handle million-token contexts, their capacity for reasoning across entire document repositories remains largely untested. Existing benchmarks are inadequate, as they are mostly limited to single long texts or rely on a "sparse retrieval" assumption-that answers can be derived from a few relevant chunks. This assumption fails for true corpus-level analysis, where evidence is highly dispersed across hundreds of documents and answers require global integration, comparison, and statistical aggregation. To address this critical gap, we introduce CorpusQA, a new benchmark scaling up to 10 million tokens, generated via a novel data synthesis framework. By decoupling reasoning from textual representation, this framework creates complex, computation-intensive queries with programmatically guaranteed ground-truth answers, challenging systems to perform holistic reasoning over vast, unstructured text without relying on fallible human annotation. We further demonstrate the utility of our framework beyond evaluation, showing that fine-tuning on our synthesized data effectively enhances an LLM's general long-context reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments reveal that even state-of-the-art long-context LLMs struggle as input length increases, and standard retrieval-augmented generation systems collapse entirely. Our findings indicate that memory-augmented agentic architectures offer a more robust alternative, suggesting a critical shift is needed from simply extending context windows to developing advanced architectures for global information synthesis.

title: Multimodal Rumor Detection Enhanced by External Evidence and Forgery Features
summary: Social media increasingly disseminates information through mixed image text posts, but rumors often exploit subtle inconsistencies and forged content, making detection based solely on post content difficult. Deep semantic mismatch rumors, which superficially align images and texts, pose particular challenges and threaten online public opinion. Existing multimodal rumor detection methods improve cross modal modeling but suffer from limited feature extraction, noisy alignment, and inflexible fusion strategies, while ignoring external factual evidence necessary for verifying complex rumors. To address these limitations, we propose a multimodal rumor detection model enhanced with external evidence and forgery features. The model uses a ResNet34 visual encoder, a BERT text encoder, and a forgery feature module extracting frequency-domain traces and compression artifacts via Fourier transformation. BLIP-generated image descriptions bridge image and text semantic spaces. A dual contrastive learning module computes contrastive losses between text image and text description pairs, improving detection of semantic inconsistencies. A gated adaptive feature-scaling fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multimodal fusion and reduces redundancy. Experiments on Weibo and Twitter datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms mainstream baselines in macro accuracy, recall, and F1 score.

title: Multi-Behavior Sequential Modeling with Transition-Aware Graph Attention Network for E-Commerce Recommendation
summary: User interactions on e-commerce platforms are inherently diverse, involving behaviors such as clicking, favoriting, adding to cart, and purchasing. The transitions between these behaviors offer valuable insights into user-item interactions, serving as a key signal for understanding evolving preferences. Consequently, there is growing interest in leveraging multi-behavior data to better capture user intent. Recent studies have explored sequential modeling of multi-behavior data, many relying on transformer-based architectures with polynomial time complexity. While effective, these approaches often incur high computational costs, limiting their applicability in large-scale industrial systems with long user sequences. To address this challenge, we propose the Transition-Aware Graph Attention Network (TGA), a linear-complexity approach for modeling multi-behavior transitions. Unlike traditional transformers that treat all behavior pairs equally, TGA constructs a structured sparse graph by identifying informative transitions from three perspectives: (a) item-level transitions, (b) category-level transitions, and (c) neighbor-level transitions. Built upon the structured graph, TGA employs a transition-aware graph Attention mechanism that jointly models user-item interactions and behavior transition types, enabling more accurate capture of sequential patterns while maintaining computational efficiency. Experiments show that TGA outperforms all state-of-the-art models while significantly reducing computational cost. Notably, TGA has been deployed in a large-scale industrial production environment, where it leads to impressive improvements in key business metrics.

title: Improving Regret Approximation for Unsupervised Dynamic Environment Generation
summary: Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) seeks to automatically generate training curricula for reinforcement learning (RL) agents, with the goal of improving generalisation and zero-shot performance. However, designing effective curricula remains a difficult problem, particularly in settings where small subsets of environment parameterisations result in significant increases in the complexity of the required policy. Current methods struggle with a difficult credit assignment problem and rely on regret approximations that fail to identify challenging levels, both of which are compounded as the size of the environment grows. We propose Dynamic Environment Generation for UED (DEGen) to enable a denser level generator reward signal, reducing the difficulty of credit assignment and allowing for UED to scale to larger environment sizes. We also introduce a new regret approximation, Maximised Negative Advantage (MNA), as a significantly improved metric to optimise for, that better identifies more challenging levels. We show empirically that MNA outperforms current regret approximations and when combined with DEGen, consistently outperforms existing methods, especially as the size of the environment grows. We have made all our code available here: https://github.com/HarryMJMead/Dynamic-Environment-Generation-for-UED.

title: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Language Models on Unicode and Romanized Sinhala
summary: The performance of Language Models (LMs) on lower-resource, morphologically rich languages like Sinhala remains under-explored, particularly for Romanized Sinhala, which is prevalent in digital communication. This paper presents a comprehensive benchmark of modern LMs on a diverse corpus of Unicode and Romanized Sinhala. We evaluate open-source models using perplexity, a measure of how well a model predicts a text, and leading closed-source models via a qualitative analysis of sentence completion. Our findings reveal that the Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407 model achieves the strongest predictive performance on Unicode text and the Mistral-7B-v0.3 model for Romanized text. The results also highlight the strong all-around performance of the Llama-3.1-8B model for both scripts. Furthermore, a significant performance disparity exists among closed-source models: Gemini-1.5-pro and DeepSeek excel at Unicode generation, whereas Claude-3.5-Sonnet is superior at handling Romanized text. These results provide an essential guide for practitioners selecting models for Sinhala-specific applications and highlight the critical role of training data in handling script variations.

title: Towards Holistic Modeling for Video Frame Interpolation with Auto-regressive Diffusion Transformers
summary: Existing video frame interpolation (VFI) methods often adopt a frame-centric approach, processing videos as independent short segments (e.g., triplets), which leads to temporal inconsistencies and motion artifacts. To overcome this, we propose a holistic, video-centric paradigm named \textbf{L}ocal \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{F}orcing for \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{F}rame \textbf{I}nterpolation (LDF-VFI). Our framework is built upon an auto-regressive diffusion transformer that models the entire video sequence to ensure long-range temporal coherence. To mitigate error accumulation inherent in auto-regressive generation, we introduce a novel skip-concatenate sampling strategy that effectively maintains temporal stability. Furthermore, LDF-VFI incorporates sparse, local attention and tiled VAE encoding, a combination that not only enables efficient processing of long sequences but also allows generalization to arbitrary spatial resolutions (e.g., 4K) at inference without retraining. An enhanced conditional VAE decoder, which leverages multi-scale features from the input video, further improves reconstruction fidelity. Empirically, LDF-VFI achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging long-sequence benchmarks, demonstrating superior per-frame quality and temporal consistency, especially in scenes with large motion. The source code is available at https://github.com/xypeng9903/LDF-VFI.

title: VCNAC: A Variable-Channel Neural Audio Codec for Mono, Stereo, and Surround Sound
summary: We present VCNAC, a variable channel neural audio codec. Our approach features a single encoder and decoder parametrization that enables native inference for different channel setups, from mono speech to cinematic 5.1 channel surround audio. Channel compatibility objectives ensure that multi-channel content maintains perceptual quality when decoded to fewer channels. The shared representation enables training of generative language models on a single set of codebooks while supporting inference-time scalability across modalities and channel configurations. Evaluation using objective spatial audio metrics and subjective listening tests demonstrates that our unified approach maintains high reconstruction quality across mono, stereo, and surround audio configurations.

title: Unsupervised Material Fingerprinting: Ultra-fast hyperelastic model discovery from full-field experimental measurements
summary: Material Fingerprinting is a lookup table-based strategy to discover material models from experimental measurements, which completely avoids the need to solve an optimization problem. In an offline phase, a comprehensive database of simulated material responses, so-called material fingerprints, is generated for a predefined experimental setup. This database can then be used repeatedly in the online phase to discover material models corresponding to experimentally measured observations. To this end, the experimentally measured fingerprint is compared with all fingerprints in the database to identify the closest match. The primary advantage of this strategy is that it does not require solving a continuous optimization problem. This avoids the associated computational costs as well as issues of ill-posedness caused by local minima in non-convex optimization landscapes. Material Fingerprinting has been successfully demonstrated for supervised datasets consisting of stress-strain pairs, as well as for unsupervised datasets involving full-field displacements and net reaction forces. However, to date, there is no experimental validation for the latter approach which is the objective of this work.

title: InstructTime++: Time Series Classification with Multimodal Language Modeling via Implicit Feature Enhancement
summary: Most existing time series classification methods adopt a discriminative paradigm that maps input sequences directly to one-hot encoded class labels. While effective, this paradigm struggles to incorporate contextual features and fails to capture semantic relationships among classes. To address these limitations, we propose InstructTime, a novel framework that reformulates time series classification as a multimodal generative task. Specifically, continuous numerical sequences, contextual textual features, and task instructions are treated as multimodal inputs, while class labels are generated as textual outputs by tuned language models. To bridge the modality gap, InstructTime introduces a time series discretization module that converts continuous sequences into discrete temporal tokens, together with an alignment projection layer and a generative self-supervised pre-training strategy to enhance cross-modal representation alignment. Building upon this framework, we further propose InstructTime++, which extends InstructTime by incorporating implicit feature modeling to compensate for the limited inductive bias of language models. InstructTime++ leverages specialized toolkits to mine informative implicit patterns from raw time series and contextual inputs, including statistical feature extraction and vision-language-based image captioning, and translates them into textual descriptions for seamless integration. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance of InstructTime++.

title: Fine-Grained Traceability for Transparent ML Pipelines
summary: Modern machine learning systems are increasingly realised as multistage pipelines, yet existing transparency mechanisms typically operate at a model level: they describe what a system is and why it behaves as it does, but not how individual data samples are operationally recorded, tracked, and verified as they traverse the pipeline. This absence of verifiable, sample-level traceability leaves practitioners and users unable to determine whether a specific sample was used, when it was processed, or whether the corresponding records remain intact over time. We introduce FG-Trac, a model-agnostic framework that establishes verifiable, fine-grained sample-level traceability throughout machine learning pipelines. FG-Trac defines an explicit mechanism for capturing and verifying sample lifecycle events across preprocessing and training, computes contribution scores explicitly grounded in training checkpoints, and anchors these traces to tamper-evident cryptographic commitments. The framework integrates without modifying model architectures or training objectives, reconstructing complete and auditable data-usage histories with practical computational overhead. Experiments on a canonical convolutional neural network and a multimodal graph learning pipeline demonstrate that FG-Trac preserves predictive performance while enabling machine learning systems to furnish verifiable evidence of how individual samples were used and propagated during model execution.

title: HumanDiffusion: A Vision-Based Diffusion Trajectory Planner with Human-Conditioned Goals for Search and Rescue UAV
comments: This paper has been accepted at HRI, Late Breaking Report, 2026
summary: Reliable human--robot collaboration in emergency scenarios requires autonomous systems that can detect humans, infer navigation goals, and operate safely in dynamic environments. This paper presents HumanDiffusion, a lightweight image-conditioned diffusion planner that generates human-aware navigation trajectories directly from RGB imagery. The system combines YOLO-11--based human detection with diffusion-driven trajectory generation, enabling a quadrotor to approach a target person and deliver medical assistance without relying on prior maps or computationally intensive planning pipelines. Trajectories are predicted in pixel space, ensuring smooth motion and a consistent safety margin around humans. We evaluate HumanDiffusion in simulation and real-world indoor mock-disaster scenarios. On a 300-sample test set, the model achieves a mean squared error of 0.02 in pixel-space trajectory reconstruction. Real-world experiments demonstrate an overall mission success rate of 80% across accident-response and search-and-locate tasks with partial occlusions. These results indicate that human-conditioned diffusion planning offers a practical and robust solution for human-aware UAV navigation in time-critical assistance settings.

title: Fractional Diffusion on Graphs: Superposition of Laplacian Semigroups and Memory
summary: Subdiffusion on graphs is often modeled by time-fractional diffusion equations, yet its structural and dynamical consequences remain unclear. We show that subdiffusive transport on graphs is a memory-driven process generated by a random time change that compresses operational time, produces long-tailed waiting times, and breaks Markovianity while preserving linearity and mass conservation. We prove that Mittag-Leffler graph dynamics admit an exact convex, mass-preserving representation as a superposition of classical heat semigroups evaluated at rescaled times, revealing fractional diffusion as ordinary diffusion acting across multiple intrinsic time scales. This framework uncovers heterogeneous, vertex-dependent memory effects and induces transport biases absent in classical diffusion, including algebraic relaxation, degree-dependent waiting times, and early-time asymmetries between sources and neighbors. These features define a subdiffusive geometry on graphs enabling particles to locally discover global shortest paths while favoring high-degree regions. Finally, we show that time-fractional diffusion arises as a singular limit of multi-rate diffusion.

AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于为图上的分数阶扩散提供了一个清晰且可解释的物理/数学基础。通过证明分数阶扩散是经典拉普拉斯半群的叠加，研究者成功地将复杂的非马尔可夫过程简化为多个尺度上的普通扩散的组合，极大地提高了模型的可解释性。这不仅澄清了分数阶扩散的“记忆”机制（源于随机时间变化），还揭示了其在图结构中导致的具体动力学后果，如有利于最短路径发现的次扩散几何，这对于理解复杂网络中的异常传输机制具有重要意义。

title: Unified Multi-Dataset Training for TBPS
summary: Text-Based Person Search (TBPS) has seen significant progress with vision-language models (VLMs), yet it remains constrained by limited training data and the fact that VLMs are not inherently pre-trained for pedestrian-centric recognition. Existing TBPS methods therefore rely on dataset-centric fine-tuning to handle distribution shift, resulting in multiple independently trained models for different datasets. While synthetic data can increase the scale needed to fine-tune VLMs, it does not eliminate dataset-specific adaptation. This motivates a fundamental question: can we train a single unified TBPS model across multiple datasets? We show that naive joint training over all datasets remains sub-optimal because current training paradigms do not scale to a large number of unique person identities and are vulnerable to noisy image-text pairs. To address these challenges, we propose Scale-TBPS with two contributions: (i) a noise-aware unified dataset curation strategy that cohesively merges diverse TBPS datasets; and (ii) a scalable discriminative identity learning framework that remains effective under a large number of unique identities. Extensive experiments on CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, RSTPReid, IIITD-20K, and UFine6926 demonstrate that a single Scale-TBPS model outperforms dataset-centric optimized models and naive joint training.

AI.tldr: 针对文本行人搜索（TBPS）中多数据集训练次优的问题，本文提出了Scale-TBPS框架，通过噪声感知数据整合和可扩展的判别性身份学习，成功训练出一个统一模型，该模型在多个数据集上表现优于独立的优化模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本行人搜索（TBPS）方法受限于训练数据不足以及视觉语言模型（VLM）并非针对行人识别预训练，导致需要对每个数据集进行独立微调。这种数据集中心化的方法导致需要训练多个独立模型。本文旨在解决“能否跨多个数据集训练一个统一的TBPS模型？”这一根本问题。
AI.method: 提出了Scale-TBPS框架，包括两个关键贡献：(i) 一种噪声感知的统一数据集整理策略，用于有凝聚力地合并多样化的TBPS数据集；(ii) 一种可扩展的判别性身份学习框架，在大规模独特身份数量下仍保持有效。
AI.result: 在CUHK-PEDES、ICFG-PEDES、RSTPReid、IIITD-20K和UFine6926等数据集上的广泛实验表明，单个Scale-TBPS模型优于以数据集为中心的优化模型和简单的联合训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了通过提出噪声感知的数据整理策略和可扩展的身份学习框架（Scale-TBPS），可以训练出一个统一的文本行人搜索模型，该模型在多个不同数据集上表现出色，解决了传统方法中数据集独立训练的限制。
AI.translation: 文本行人搜索（TBPS）随着视觉语言模型（VLM）的发展取得了显著进步，但它仍然受到训练数据有限以及VLM并非天生为行人中心识别预训练的限制。因此，现有的TBPS方法依赖于以数据集为中心的微调来处理分布漂移，导致针对不同数据集需要多个独立训练的模型。虽然合成数据可以增加微调VLM所需的规模，但它并不能消除针对特定数据集的适应性。这引出了一个基本问题：我们能否跨多个数据集训练一个单一的统一TBPS模型？我们发现，对所有数据集进行简单的联合训练仍然是次优的，因为当前的训练范式无法扩展到大量的独特人物身份，并且容易受到噪声图像-文本对的影响。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Scale-TBPS，包含两个贡献：(i) 一种噪声感知的统一数据集整理策略，可以有凝聚力地合并不同的TBPS数据集；(ii) 一种可扩展的判别性身份学习框架，在大量独特身份下仍然有效。在CUHK-PEDES、ICFG-PEDES、RSTPReid、IIITD-20K和UFine6926上的广泛实验表明，单个Scale-TBPS模型优于以数据集为中心优化的模型和简单的联合训练。
AI.summary: 针对文本行人搜索（TBPS）中模型依赖特定数据集独立训练的问题，本文提出了Scale-TBPS框架，旨在训练一个跨数据集的统一模型。Scale-TBPS通过引入噪声感知的统一数据集整理策略和可扩展的判别性身份学习框架，解决了简单联合训练中身份数量扩展和数据噪声的挑战。实验证明，单个Scale-TBPS模型在五个主要TBPS数据集上的性能均优于数据集中心化优化模型和朴素联合训练。
AI.keywords: 文本行人搜索, 统一训练, 多数据集, 噪声感知, 身份学习
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的多数据集训练范式来解决文本行人搜索（TBPS）领域中模型碎片化（依赖特定数据集独立训练）的问题。通过设计噪声感知的数据整合和可扩展的身份学习框架，Scale-TBPS克服了简单联合训练中身份数量难以扩展和数据噪声敏感的挑战。这对于推动TBPS模型向更通用、更鲁棒的方向发展具有重要意义，特别是对于利用大规模VLM进行行人识别任务。

title: Parallel Collaborative ADMM Privacy Computing and Adaptive GPU Acceleration for Distributed Edge Networks
summary: Distributed computing has been widely applied in distributed edge networks for reducing the processing burden of high-dimensional data centralization, where a high-dimensional computational task is decomposed into multiple low-dimensional collaborative processing tasks or multiple edge nodes use distributed data to train a global model. However, the computing power of a single-edge node is limited, and collaborative computing will cause information leakage and excessive communication overhead. In this paper, we design a parallel collaborative distributed alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) and propose a three-phase parallel collaborative ADMM privacy computing (3P-ADMM-PC2) algorithm for distributed computing in edge networks, where the Paillier homomorphic encryption is utilized to protect data privacy during interactions. Especially, a quantization method is introduced, which maps the real numbers to a positive integer interval without affecting the homomorphic operations. To address the architectural mismatch between large-integer and Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) computing, we transform high-bitwidth computations into low-bitwidth matrix and vector operations. Thus the GPU can be utilized to implement parallel encryption and decryption computations with long keys. Finally, a GPU-accelerated 3P-ADMM-PC2 is proposed to optimize the collaborative computing tasks. Meanwhile, large-scale computational tasks are conducted in network topologies with varying numbers of edge nodes. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed 3P-ADMM-PC2 has excellent mean square error performance, which is close to that of distributed ADMM without privacy-preserving. Compared to centralized ADMM and distributed ADMM implemented with Central Processing Unit (CPU) computation, the proposed scheme demonstrates a significant speedup ratio.

AI.title_translation: 分布式边缘网络中的并行协作ADMM隐私计算与自适应GPU加速
AI.tldr: 针对分布式边缘网络中的计算限制和隐私泄露问题，本文提出了一种基于Paillier同态加密和GPU加速的并行协作ADMM隐私计算算法（3P-ADMM-PC2），实现了接近非隐私方案的精度和显著的加速比。
AI.motivation: 解决分布式边缘网络中，高维数据计算任务分解时，单个边缘节点计算能力有限、协作计算导致信息泄露以及通信开销过大的问题。
AI.method: 设计了一种并行协作分布式交替方向乘子法（ADMM），并提出了三阶段并行协作ADMM隐私计算（3P-ADMM-PC2）算法。该算法利用Paillier同态加密保护数据隐私，引入量化方法将实数映射到正整数区间。为解决大整数计算与GPU架构不匹配的问题，将高位宽计算转换为低位宽矩阵和向量操作，从而利用GPU实现长密钥的并行加密和解密计算，最终提出GPU加速的3P-ADMM-PC2方案。
AI.result: 提出的3P-ADMM-PC2具有出色的均方误差（MSE）性能，接近于未进行隐私保护的分布式ADMM。与集中式ADMM和采用CPU计算实现的分布式ADMM相比，该方案展现出显著的加速比。
AI.translation: 分布式计算已广泛应用于分布式边缘网络中，以减轻高维数据集中处理的负担。在这种网络中，高维计算任务被分解为多个低维协作处理任务，或多个边缘节点利用分布式数据训练一个全局模型。然而，单个边缘节点的计算能力有限，且协作计算会导致信息泄露和通信开销过大。在本文中，我们设计了一种并行协作分布式交替方向乘子法（ADMM），并提出了一种三阶段并行协作ADMM隐私计算（3P-ADMM-PC2）算法，用于边缘网络中的分布式计算，其中利用Paillier同态加密来保护交互过程中的数据隐私。特别地，引入了一种量化方法，将实数映射到一个正整数区间，且不影响同态操作。为解决大整数计算与图形处理单元（GPU）架构不匹配的问题，我们将高位宽计算转换为低位宽矩阵和向量操作。因此，可以利用GPU实现长密钥的并行加密和解密计算。最后，提出了一种GPU加速的3P-ADMM-PC2方案来优化协作计算任务。同时，在具有不同数量边缘节点的网络拓扑中进行了大规模计算任务。实验结果表明，所提出的3P-ADMM-PC2具有出色的均方误差性能，接近于未进行隐私保护的分布式ADMM。与集中式ADMM和采用中央处理单元（CPU）计算实现的分布式ADMM相比，所提出的方案展现出显著的加速比。
AI.summary: 本文针对分布式边缘网络中协作计算的计算限制、隐私泄露和高通信开销问题，提出了一种名为3P-ADMM-PC2的并行协作ADMM隐私计算算法。该算法结合Paillier同态加密实现数据隐私保护，并通过引入量化方法和将高位宽计算转换为低位宽操作，克服了GPU处理大整数的架构障碍，实现了自适应GPU加速。实验证明，3P-ADMM-PC2在保持高精度（接近非隐私ADMM）的同时，实现了显著的计算加速。
AI.keywords: 并行协作ADMM, 隐私计算, Paillier同态加密, GPU加速, 分布式边缘网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于成功地将隐私保护（Paillier同态加密）与高性能计算（GPU加速）有效地结合起来，以解决分布式边缘网络中的核心挑战。Paillier加密通常涉及大整数运算，这与GPU擅长的低位宽并行浮点运算存在架构不匹配。作者通过引入量化方法和将高位宽计算巧妙地转换为低位宽矩阵/向量操作，解决了这一架构障碍，使得GPU能够加速原本计算密集型的隐私保护操作。这对于推动安全多方计算在资源受限的边缘环境中的实际应用具有重要意义，提供了一个兼顾效率、精度和隐私的实用方案。

title: Interoperable Architecture for Digital Identity Delegation for AI Agents with Blockchain Integration
summary: Verifiable delegation in digital identity systems remains unresolved across centralized, federated, and self-sovereign identity (SSI) environments, particularly where both human users and autonomous AI agents must exercise and transfer authority without exposing primary credentials or private keys. We introduce a unified framework that enables bounded, auditable, and least-privilege delegation across heterogeneous identity ecosystems. The framework includes four key elements: Delegation Grants (DGs), first-class authorization artefacts that encode revocable transfers of authority with enforced scope reduction; a Canonical Verification Context (CVC) that normalizes verification requests into a single structured representation independent of protocols or credential formats; a layered reference architecture that separates trust anchoring, credential and proof validation, policy evaluation, and protocol mediation via a Trust Gateway; and an explicit treatment of blockchain anchoring as an optional integrity layer rather than a structural dependency. Together, these elements advance interoperable delegation and auditability and provide a foundation for future standardization, implementation, and integration of autonomous agents into trusted digital identity infrastructures.

AI.title_translation: 针对集成区块链的AI代理数字身份授权的互操作架构
AI.tldr: 提出了一种四要素互操作架构（DGs、CVC、分层架构、可选区块链），旨在解决人类和AI代理在不暴露私钥的情况下，安全、可审计地进行数字身份授权的问题。
AI.motivation: 解决中心化、联邦和自愿主权身份（SSI）环境中可验证授权的难题，特别是人类用户和自主AI代理需要在不暴露主凭证或私钥的情况下行使和转移权限。
AI.method: 引入了一个统一的框架，该框架包含四个关键要素：授权许可（DGs，编码可撤销、范围缩减的权限转移）、规范验证上下文（CVC，规范化验证请求）、分层参考架构（通过信任网关分离核心功能）、以及将区块链锚定作为可选的完整性层处理。
AI.result: 实现了跨异构身份生态系统的有界、可审计和最小权限授权。这些要素提升了互操作性授权和可审计性。
AI.conclusion: 为未来自主代理的标准化、实施和集成到可信数字身份基础设施中奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 数字身份系统中的可验证授权问题在中心化、联邦和自愿主权身份（SSI）环境中仍未得到解决，尤其是在人类用户和自主AI代理都必须在不暴露主凭证或私钥的情况下行使和转移权限的场景。我们引入了一个统一的框架，该框架能够在异构身份生态系统之间实现有界、可审计和最小权限的授权。该框架包括四个关键要素：授权许可（DGs），作为一级授权工件，编码了具有强制范围缩减的可撤销权限转移；规范验证上下文（CVC），将验证请求标准化为一个单一的结构化表示，与协议或凭证格式无关；一个分层参考架构，通过信任网关分离信任锚定、凭证和证明验证、策略评估和协议调解；以及将区块链锚定明确视为可选的完整性层，而非结构性依赖。这些要素共同推进了互操作性授权和可审计性，并为未来自主代理的标准化、实施和集成到可信数字身份基础设施中奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个统一的、可互操作的框架，以解决跨中心化、联邦和自愿主权身份系统的人类用户和自主AI代理的可验证数字身份授权难题。该框架通过授权许可（DGs）、规范验证上下文（CVC）、带有信任网关的分层参考架构以及可选的区块链锚定这四个要素，确保在不暴露主凭证的情况下实现有界、可审计和最小权限的权限转移。
AI.keywords: 数字身份授权, AI代理, 区块链集成, 互操作架构, 自主主权身份
AI.comments: 核心创新在于创建了一个统一的框架，该框架抽象了底层身份系统（中心化与SSI）的异构性，并明确解决了AI代理的复杂需求。将区块链视为可选的完整性层而非强制的结构依赖，是一种增强灵活性和采用性的实用设计选择。授权许可（DGs）和规范验证上下文（CVC）的引入为安全、有界的授权提供了具体且可标准化的机制，为未来数字身份基础设施中AI代理的集成奠定了重要基础。

title: Stealthy bias injection attack detection based on Kullback-Leibler divergence in stochastic linear systems
summary: This paper studies the design of detection observers against stealthy bias injection attacks in stochastic linear systems under Gaussian noise, considering adversaries that exploit noise and inject crafted bias signals into a subset of sensors in a slow and coordinated manner, thereby achieving malicious objectives while remaining stealthy. To address such attacks, we formulate the observer design as a max-min optimization problem to enhance the detectability of worst-case BIAs, which attain a prescribed attack impact with the least detectability evaluated via Kullback-Leibler divergence. To reduce the computational complexity of the derived non-convex design problem, we consider the detectability of worst-case BIAs at three specific time instants: attack onset, one step after attack occurrence, and the steady state. We prove that the Kalman filter is optimal for maximizing the BIA detectability at the attack onset, regardless of the subset of attacked sensors. For the one-step and steady-state cases, the observer design problems are approximated by bi-convex optimization problems, which can be efficiently solved using alternating optimization and alternating direction method of multipliers. Moreover, more tractable linear matrix inequality relaxations are developed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed stealth-aware detection framework is demonstrated through an application to a thermal system.

AI.title_translation: 基于 Kullback-Leibler 散度的随机线性系统隐蔽偏差注入攻击检测
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种在随机线性系统（高斯噪声下）中检测隐蔽偏差注入攻击（BIA）的方法。攻击者会缓慢且协调地利用噪声并注入精心设计的偏差信号到部分传感器，以实现恶意目标并保持隐蔽。该方法将观测器设计设计为最大-最小优化问题，以增强最坏情况 BIA 的可检测性，其可检测性通过 Kullback-Leibler 散度进行评估。为了降低计算复杂度，研究考虑了攻击发生时、攻击发生后一步以及稳态这三个时间点的最坏情况 BIA 可检测性。研究证明卡尔曼滤波器在攻击发生时最大化 BIA 可检测性方面是最优的。对于攻击发生后一步和稳态情况，观测器设计问题被近似为双凸优化问题，并可通过交替优化和 ADMM 高效求解。此外，还开发了更易处理的线性矩阵不等式松弛方法。最后，通过热力学系统应用证明了所提出的隐蔽感知检测框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是为了应对随机线性系统中存在的隐蔽偏差注入攻击（BIA）。这类攻击者会利用噪声并缓慢、协调地向部分传感器注入偏差信号，从而在保持隐蔽的同时实现恶意目标。
AI.method: 该研究将观测器设计设计为一个最大-最小优化问题，以增强最坏情况 BIA 的可检测性，并使用 Kullback-Leibler 散度来评估可检测性。为了降低计算复杂度，研究考虑了攻击发生时、攻击发生后一步以及稳态这三个时间点的可检测性。针对不同情况，分别采用了卡尔曼滤波器（攻击发生时）、双凸优化（攻击发生后一步和稳态）以及线性矩阵不等式松弛等方法。
AI.result: 研究证明卡尔曼滤波器在攻击发生时最大化 BIA 可检测性方面是最优的。对于攻击发生后一步和稳态情况，通过双凸优化和线性矩阵不等式松弛方法，可以高效地求解观测器设计问题。最后，通过热力学系统应用验证了该检测框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于 Kullback-Leibler 散度的检测框架能够有效地检测随机线性系统中的隐蔽偏差注入攻击，并且通过优化方法可以实现高效的观测器设计。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在高斯噪声下的随机线性系统中，针对隐蔽偏差注入攻击（BIA）的设计检测观测器。考虑到对手利用噪声并以缓慢且协调的方式，将精心设计的偏差信号注入到部分传感器中，从而在保持隐蔽的同时实现恶意目标。为了应对此类攻击，我们将观测器设计设计为一个最大-最小优化问题，以增强最坏情况 BIA 的可检测性，最坏情况 BIA 通过 Kullback-Leibler 散度评估可检测性，并达到预定的攻击影响。为了降低所推导的非凸设计问题的计算复杂度，我们考虑了在三个特定时间点：攻击发生时、攻击发生后一步以及稳态时的最坏情况 BIA 的可检测性。我们证明了卡尔曼滤波器在最大化攻击发生时的 BIA 可检测性方面是最优的，而与被攻击传感器的子集无关。对于攻击发生后一步和稳态情况，观测器设计问题被近似为双凸优化问题，可以使用交替优化和交替方向乘子法（ADMM）进行高效求解。此外，还开发了更易处理的线性矩阵不等式松弛方法。最后，通过热力学系统的应用证明了所提出的隐蔽感知检测框架的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种在随机线性系统中检测隐蔽偏差注入攻击（BIA）的方法。该方法通过最大化最坏情况 BIA 的可检测性来设计观测器，并利用 Kullback-Leibler 散度进行评估。为提高计算效率，研究简化了问题，并证明了卡尔曼滤波器的最优性，同时提出了双凸优化和线性矩阵不等式松弛方法来求解复杂情况。最后，通过热力学系统应用验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 隐蔽偏差注入攻击, 随机线性系统, Kullback-Leibler 散度, 观测器设计, 卡尔曼滤波器
AI.comments: 该研究在随机线性系统中引入了隐蔽偏差注入攻击的检测方法，并利用 Kullback-Leibler 散度量化攻击的可检测性，具有一定的理论和实践意义。然而，对于攻击者可能采用的更复杂的攻击策略以及在非高斯噪声环境下的鲁棒性方面，可能还有待进一步研究。此外，实际部署中的计算开销和实时性也是需要考虑的因素。

title: Two-Class Joint Source-Channel Coding: Expurgated Exponents with i.i.d. Distributions
summary: This paper studies expurgated exponents for joint source-channel coding of discrete memoryless sources and channels under i.i.d. random coding. We show that a two-class partitioning of source sequences, where the codeword distribution depends on the source type, achieves an exponent at least as high as that of optimal single-class coding, in which the codeword distribution is independent of the source message.

AI.title_translation: 两类联合源信道编码：具有i.i.d.分布的被剔除指数
AI.tldr: 通过将源序列分成两类并根据类型调整码字分布，这种联合源信道编码方法在i.i.d.随机编码下，其性能指数不低于传统的单类编码方法。
AI.motivation: 研究在i.i.d.随机编码下，针对离散无记忆源和信道的联合源信道编码的“被剔除指数”（expurgated exponents）。
AI.method: 提出了一种两类源序列分区（two-class partitioning of source sequences），其中码字分布依赖于源类型，并在i.i.d.随机编码下进行分析。
AI.result: 所提出的两类分区方法，其码字分布依赖于源类型，可以实现至少与最优单类编码（码字分布独立于源信息）相同高的指数。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在i.i.d.随机编码下，离散无记忆源和信道的联合源信道编码的被剔除指数。我们证明了一种两类源序列分区，其中码字分布依赖于源类型，可以实现至少与最优单类编码（其中码字分布独立于源信息）一样高的指数。

title: Random Gilbert-Varshamov Codes for Joint Source-Channel Coding
comments: This paper has been submitted to ISIT 2026 for review
summary: We propose a random coding technique for joint source-channel coding of discrete memoryless sources and channels. The approach builds on the random Gilbert-Varshamov code construction of Somekh-Baruch et al. and extends it to the joint source-channel setting. We show that the resulting ensemble attains the maximum of the random-coding and expurgated error exponents.

title: Economic Warehouse Lot Scheduling: Approximation Schemes via Efficiently-Representable DP-Encoded Policies
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2412.11184
summary:
In this focused technical paper, we present long-awaited algorithmic advances toward the efficient construction of near-optimal replenishment policies for a true inventory management classic, the economic warehouse lot scheduling problem. While this paradigm has accumulated a massive body of surrounding literature since its inception in the late '50s, we are still very much in the dark as far as basic computational questions are concerned, perhaps due to the intrinsic complexity of dynamic policies in this context. The latter feature forced earlier attempts to either study highly-structured classes of policies or to forgo provably-good performance guarantees altogether; to this day, rigorously analyzable results have been few and far between.
  The current paper develops novel analytical foundations for directly competing against dynamic policies. Combined with further algorithmic progress and newly-gained insights, these ideas culminate in a polynomial-time approximation scheme for constantly-many commodities. In this regard, the efficient design of $ε$-optimal dynamic policies appeared to have been out of reach, since beyond their inherent algorithmic challenges, even the polynomial-space representation of such policies has been a fundamental open question.

title: Obscuring Data Contamination Through Translation: Evidence from Arabic Corpora
summary:
Data contamination undermines the validity of Large Language Model evaluation by enabling models to rely on memorized benchmark content rather than true generalization. While prior work has proposed contamination detection methods, these approaches are largely limited to English benchmarks, leaving multilingual contamination poorly understood. In this work, we investigate contamination dynamics in multilingual settings by fine-tuning several open-weight LLMs on varying proportions of Arabic datasets and evaluating them on original English benchmarks. To detect memorization, we extend the Tested Slot Guessing method with a choice-reordering strategy and incorporate Min-K% probability analysis, capturing both behavioral and distributional contamination signals.
  Our results show that translation into Arabic suppresses conventional contamination indicators, yet models still benefit from exposure to contaminated data, particularly those with stronger Arabic capabilities. This effect is consistently reflected in rising Mink% scores and increased cross-lingual answer consistency as contamination levels grow. To address this blind spot, we propose Translation-Aware Contamination Detection, which identifies contamination by comparing signals across multiple translated benchmark variants rather than English alone. The Translation-Aware Contamination Detection reliably exposes contamination even when English-only methods fail. Together, our findings highlight the need for multilingual, translation-aware evaluation pipelines to ensure fair, transparent, and reproducible assessment of LLMs.

title: On the Effectiveness of Mempool-based Transaction Auditing
summary:
While the literature features a number of proposals to defend against transaction manipulation attacks, existing proposals are still not integrated within large blockchains, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Cardano. Instead, the user community opted to rely on more practical but ad-hoc solutions (such as Mempool.space) that aim at detecting censorship and transaction displacement attacks by auditing discrepancies in the mempools of so-called observers.
  In this paper, we precisely analyze, for the first time, the interplay between mempool auditing and the ability to detect censorship and transaction displacement attacks by malicious miners in Bitcoin and Ethereum. Our analysis shows that mempool auditing can result in mis-accusations against miners with a probability larger than 25% in some settings. On a positive note, however, we show that mempool auditing schemes can successfully audit the execution of any two transactions (with an overwhelming probability of 99.9%) if they are consistently received by all observers and sent at least 30 seconds apart from each other. As a direct consequence, our findings show, for the first time, that batch-order fair-ordering schemes can offer only strong fairness guarantees for a limited subset of transactions in real-world deployments.

title: Graph-Based Adaptive Planning for Coordinated Dual-Arm Robotic Disassembly of Electronic Devices (eGRAP)
summary: E-waste is growing rapidly while recycling rates remain low. We propose an electronic-device Graph-based Adaptive Planning (eGRAP) that integrates vision, dynamic planning, and dual-arm execution for autonomous disassembly. A camera-equipped arm identifies parts and estimates their poses, and a directed graph encodes which parts must be removed first. A scheduler uses topological ordering of this graph to select valid next steps and assign them to two robot arms, allowing independent tasks to run in parallel. One arm carries a screwdriver (with an eye-in-hand depth camera) and the other holds or handles components. We demonstrate eGRAP on 3.5in hard drives: as parts are unscrewed and removed, the system updates its graph and plan online. Experiments show consistent full disassembly of each HDD, with high success rates and efficient cycle times, illustrating the method's ability to adaptively coordinate dual-arm tasks in real time.

title: Lineup Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus (L-RAPM): Basketball Lineup Ratings with Informed Priors
summary: Identifying combinations of players (that is, lineups) in basketball - and other sports - that perform well when they play together is one of the most important tasks in sports analytics. One of the main challenges associated with this task is the frequent substitutions that occur during a game, which results in highly sparse data. In particular, a National Basketball Association (NBA) team will use more than 600 lineups during a season, which translates to an average lineup having seen the court in approximately 25-30 possessions. Inevitably, any statistics that one collects for these lineups are going to be noisy, with low predictive value. Yet, there is no existing work (in the public at least) that addresses this problem. In this work, we propose a regression-based approach that controls for the opposition faced by each lineup, while it also utilizes information about the players making up the lineups. Our experiments show that L-RAPM provides improved predictive power than the currently used baseline, and this improvement increases as the sample size for the lineups gets smaller.

title: DWPP: Dynamic Window Pure Pursuit Considering Velocity and Acceleration Constraints
summary: Pure pursuit and its variants are widely used for mobile robot path tracking owing to their simplicity and computational efficiency. However, many conventional approaches do not explicitly account for velocity and acceleration constraints, resulting in discrepancies between commanded and actual velocities that result in overshoot and degraded tracking performance. To address this problem, this paper proposes dynamic window pure pursuit (DWPP), which fundamentally reformulates the command velocity computation process to explicitly incorporate velocity and acceleration constraints. Specifically, DWPP formulates command velocity computation in the velocity space (the $v$-$ω$ plane) and selects the command velocity as the point within the dynamic window that is closest to the line $ω= κv$. Experimental results demonstrate that DWPP avoids constraint-violating commands and achieves superior path-tracking accuracy compared with conventional pure pursuit methods. The proposed method has been integrated into the official Nav2 repository and is publicly available (https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2).

AI.title_translation: DWPP：考虑速度和加速度约束的动态窗口纯跟踪算法
AI.tldr: 针对传统纯跟踪算法不考虑速度/加速度约束导致性能下降的问题，本文提出了DWPP算法，它在速度空间中使用动态窗口明确纳入这些约束，从而实现了更高的路径跟踪精度。

title: RadixMLP -- Intra-batch Deduplication for Causal Transformers
summary: Batch inference workloads for causal transformer models frequently process sequences that share common prefixes, such as system prompts, few-shot examples, or shared queries. Standard inference engines treat each sequence independently, redundantly recomputing identical MLP activations for every copy of the shared prefix. We introduce RadixMLP, a technique that exploits the position-wise nature of MLPs, LayerNorms, linear projections, and embeddings to eliminate this redundancy. RadixMLP dynamically maps batches to a prefix trie, gathering shared segments into a compressed representation for position-wise computation and scattering results back only at attention boundaries. RadixMLP is stateless and operates within a single forward pass. In end-to-end serving benchmarks on MS~MARCO v1.1 with Qwen3 models (0.6B to 8B parameters), RadixMLP achieves 1.44-1.59$\times$ speedups in realistic reranking workloads, with up to $5\times$ speedups on synthetic benchmarks with longer shared prefixes. Our code is available at https://github.com/michaelfeil/radix-mlp.

AI.tldr: 针对因果Transformer批量推理中序列共享前缀导致的冗余计算问题，本文提出RadixMLP技术。它利用前缀树对共享前缀进行批内去重和压缩计算，显著加速了重新排序等工作负载（最高可达5倍）。
AI.motivation: 在因果Transformer模型的批量推理工作中，序列经常共享公共前缀（如系统提示或共享查询），但标准推理引擎独立处理每个序列，导致冗余地重复计算这些共享前缀的MLP激活。
AI.method: 引入RadixMLP，利用MLPs、LayerNorms、线性投影和嵌入等的位置感知特性来消除冗余。它动态地将批次映射到前缀树（prefix trie），将共享段汇集到压缩表示中进行位置感知计算，并仅在注意力边界处将结果分散回原位。该方法是无状态的，并在单个前向传播中操作。
AI.result: 在MS~MARCO v1.1上使用Qwen3模型（0.6B至8B参数）的端到端服务基准测试中，RadixMLP在真实的重排序工作负载中实现了1.44至1.59倍的加速，在具有更长共享前缀的合成基准测试中实现了高达5倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: RadixMLP通过利用序列共享前缀的特性进行批内去重，成功提高了因果Transformer模型的批量推理速度，显著加速了重新排序等实际工作负载。

AI.summary: 本文提出了RadixMLP，旨在解决因果Transformer模型批量推理中序列共享前缀导致的MLP激活冗余计算问题。RadixMLP通过动态映射到前缀树，对共享段进行压缩和位置感知计算（应用于MLPs、LayerNorms等），从而实现批内去重。该技术是无状态的，并在单个前向传播中完成。实验证明，在实际的重排序任务中，RadixMLP实现了1.44至1.59倍的加速，在合成测试中最高可达5倍加速。
AI.keywords: RadixMLP, 批内去重, 因果Transformer, 批量推理, 前缀树
AI.comments: 这项工作的重要性在于解决了因果Transformer批量推理中常见的共享前缀带来的计算效率低下问题。RadixMLP的创新点在于它利用了MLP、LayerNorm等层的“位置感知”（position-wise）特性进行批内动态去重，而不是依赖传统的KV缓存优化。通过将批次映射到前缀树进行压缩计算，它为重新排序和RAG等工作负载提供了显著的推理加速，是一种实用的系统级优化。

title: Plug-and-Play Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for Large-Scale Flow Control
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promising results in active flow control (AFC), yet progress in the field remains difficult to assess as existing studies rely on heterogeneous observation and actuation schemes, numerical setups, and evaluation protocols. Current AFC benchmarks attempt to address these issues but heavily rely on external computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, are not fully differentiable, and provide limited 3D and multi-agent support. To overcome these limitations, we introduce FluidGym, the first standalone, fully differentiable benchmark suite for RL in AFC. Built entirely in PyTorch on top of the GPU-accelerated PICT solver, FluidGym runs in a single Python stack, requires no external CFD software, and provides standardized evaluation protocols. We present baseline results with PPO and SAC and release all environments, datasets, and trained models as public resources. FluidGym enables systematic comparison of control methods, establishes a scalable foundation for future research in learning-based flow control, and is available at https://github.com/safe-autonomous-systems/fluidgym.

AI.title_translation: 强化学习算法在大规模流动控制中的即插即用基准测试
AI.tldr: 针对主动流动控制（AFC）中RL算法评估标准不统一的问题，本文推出了FluidGym，这是一个基于PyTorch和GPU加速PICT求解器的首个独立、完全可微分的RL基准测试套件，无需外部CFD软件，提供标准化协议，并发布了PPO和SAC的基线结果。
AI.motivation: 尽管强化学习（RL）在主动流动控制（AFC）中前景广阔，但由于现有的观察、驱动、数值设置和评估协议各不相同，使得该领域的进展难以评估。此外，当前的AFC基准测试依赖外部计算流体动力学（CFD）求解器、缺乏完全可微分性，且对3D和多智能体的支持有限。
AI.method: 引入了FluidGym，这是首个独立、完全可微分的RL基准测试套件，专门用于主动流动控制（AFC）。它完全基于PyTorch构建，并使用了GPU加速的PICT求解器。FluidGym运行在一个单一的Python堆栈中，不需要外部CFD软件，并提供了标准化的评估协议。
AI.result: 使用PPO和SAC算法提供了基线测试结果。所有环境、数据集和训练模型均作为公共资源发布。
AI.conclusion: FluidGym能够对控制方法进行系统比较，并为未来基于学习的流动控制研究奠定了可扩展的基础。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）在主动流动控制（AFC）中已显示出可喜的成果，但由于现有研究依赖于异构的观察和驱动方案、数值设置和评估协议，使得该领域的进展难以评估。当前的AFC基准试图解决这些问题，但它们严重依赖外部计算流体动力学（CFD）求解器，并非完全可微分，并且对3D和多智能体的支持有限。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了FluidGym，这是首个用于AFC中RL的独立、完全可微分的基准测试套件。FluidGym完全基于PyTorch构建，并建立在GPU加速的PICT求解器之上，它运行在单一的Python堆栈中，无需外部CFD软件，并提供标准化的评估协议。我们展示了使用PPO和SAC的基线结果，并发布了所有环境、数据集和训练模型作为公共资源。FluidGym能够对控制方法进行系统比较，为未来基于学习的流动控制研究建立了可扩展的基础，该资源可在https://github.com/safe-autonomous-systems/fluidgym 获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了FluidGym，这是一个针对主动流动控制（AFC）中强化学习（RL）算法的全新、独立的、完全可微分的基准测试套件。它旨在解决现有AFC研究中评估标准不统一以及现有基准对外部CFD求解器的依赖、缺乏可微分性和有限的3D/多智能体支持等问题。FluidGym完全基于PyTorch和GPU加速的PICT求解器构建，实现了单一Python堆栈操作。作者提供了PPO和SAC的基线结果，并公开了所有资源，从而为系统比较控制方法和未来研究奠定了可扩展的基础。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 主动流动控制, 基准测试, 可微分CFD, FluidGym
AI.comments: FluidGym的创新性在于它解决了RL在流体控制领域长期存在的评估难题，即缺乏统一且高效的基准。通过在PyTorch中实现完全可微分、GPU加速的CFD求解器（PICT），它极大地提高了研究的可访问性和效率，允许研究人员在不依赖昂贵或复杂的外部CFD软件的情况下快速迭代和比较算法。其“即插即用”特性和标准化协议的提供，对于推动基于学习的流体控制研究的系统化和规模化发展具有重要意义。

title: LiViBench: An Omnimodal Benchmark for Interactive Livestream Video Understanding
summary: The development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has advanced general video understanding. However, existing video evaluation benchmarks primarily focus on non-interactive videos, such as movies and recordings. To fill this gap, this paper proposes the first omnimodal benchmark for interactive livestream videos, LiViBench. It features a diverse set of 24 tasks, highlighting the perceptual, reasoning, and livestream-specific challenges. To efficiently construct the dataset, we design a standardized semi-automatic annotation workflow that incorporates the human-in-the-loop at multiple stages. The workflow leverages multiple MLLMs to form a multi-agent system for comprehensive video description and uses a seed-question-driven method to construct high-quality annotations. All interactive videos in the benchmark include audio, speech, and real-time comments modalities. To enhance models' understanding of interactive videos, we design tailored two-stage instruction-tuning and propose a Video-to-Comment Retrieval (VCR) module to improve the model's ability to utilize real-time comments. Based on these advancements, we develop LiVi-LLM-7B, an MLLM with enhanced knowledge of interactive livestreams. Experiments show that our model outperforms larger open-source models with up to 72B parameters, narrows the gap with leading proprietary models on LiViBench, and achieves enhanced performance on general video benchmarks, including VideoMME, LongVideoBench, MLVU, and VideoEval-Pro.

AI.title_translation: LiViBench：一个用于交互式直播视频理解的全模态基准
AI.tldr: 提出了首个用于交互式直播视频理解的全模态基准LiViBench，并开发了LiVi-LLM-7B模型，该模型通过利用实时评论等模态，在理解交互式视频方面超越了更大的开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频评估基准主要关注非交互式视频（如电影和录像），缺乏针对交互式直播视频的评估基准，因此需要一个全模态基准来填补这一空白并突出直播特有的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了包含24项任务的LiViBench全模态基准，数据包含音频、语音和实时评论模态。设计了标准化的半自动标注流程，该流程利用多智能体系统和种子问题驱动方法。设计了定制化的两阶段指令微调，并提出了视频到评论检索（VCR）模块。基于此开发了LiVi-LLM-7B模型。
AI.result: LiVi-LLM-7B模型在LiViBench上性能优于参数量高达72B的更大开源模型，缩小了与领先专有模型的差距，并在多个通用视频基准（包括VideoMME、LongVideoBench等）上获得了增强的性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了首个交互式直播视频全模态基准LiViBench，并开发的LiVi-LLM-7B模型证明了其在理解交互式直播内容方面的有效性和优越性，成功超越了现有大型开源模型。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的发展推动了通用视频理解的进步。然而，现有的视频评估基准主要关注非交互式视频，如电影和录像。为了填补这一空白，本文提出了首个用于交互式直播视频的全模态基准——LiViBench。它包含24项多样化的任务，着重突出了感知、推理以及直播特有的挑战。为了高效构建数据集，我们设计了一个标准化的半自动标注流程，该流程在多个阶段纳入了人工参与（human-in-the-loop）。该流程利用多个MLLMs组成多智能体系统进行全面的视频描述，并采用种子问题驱动的方法构建高质量的标注。该基准中的所有交互式视频都包含音频、语音和实时评论模态。为了增强模型对交互式视频的理解，我们设计了定制化的两阶段指令微调，并提出了视频到评论检索（VCR）模块，以提高模型利用实时评论的能力。基于这些进展，我们开发了LiVi-LLM-7B，一个增强了交互式直播知识的MLLM。实验表明，我们的模型性能优于参数量高达72B的更大开源模型，缩小了在LiViBench上与领先专有模型的差距，并在通用视频基准（包括VideoMME、LongVideoBench、MLVU和VideoEval-Pro）上取得了增强的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LiViBench，这是首个专为交互式直播视频理解设计的全模态基准，旨在弥补现有非交互式视频评估的空白。该基准包含24项多样化任务，并结合了音频、语音和实时评论模态。作者设计了半自动、多智能体标注流程，并提出了定制化的两阶段指令微调和视频到评论检索（VCR）模块。基于这些创新，他们开发了LiVi-LLM-7B模型，实验证明该模型优于参数量更大的开源模型，并在通用视频基准上表现增强。
AI.keywords: 全模态基准, 直播视频, 交互式视频理解, 多模态大语言模型, LiViBench
AI.comments: 创新性在于首次针对交互式直播视频理解这一复杂且重要的领域提出了全模态基准（LiViBench）。直播视频的交互性和实时评论模态对现有模型提出了新的挑战。论文通过设计多智能体半自动标注流程、定制化的两阶段指令微调以及视频到评论检索（VCR）模块，有效地解决了这些挑战，并成功开发出在特定领域和通用任务上均表现优异的LiVi-LLM-7B，为未来多模态大模型在实时交互场景中的应用奠定了基础。

title: SpatialV2A: Visual-Guided High-fidelity Spatial Audio Generation
summary: While video-to-audio generation has achieved remarkable progress in semantic and temporal alignment, most existing studies focus solely on these aspects, paying limited attention to the spatial perception and immersive quality of the synthesized audio. This limitation stems largely from current models' reliance on mono audio datasets, which lack the binaural spatial information needed to learn visual-to-spatial audio mappings. To address this gap, we introduce two key contributions: we construct BinauralVGGSound, the first large-scale video-binaural audio dataset designed to support spatially aware video-to-audio generation; and we propose a end-to-end spatial audio generation framework guided by visual cues, which explicitly models spatial features. Our framework incorporates a visual-guided audio spatialization module that ensures the generated audio exhibits realistic spatial attributes and layered spatial depth while maintaining semantic and temporal alignment. Experiments show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art models in spatial fidelity and delivers a more immersive auditory experience, without sacrificing temporal or semantic consistency. All datasets, code, and model checkpoints will be publicly released to facilitate future research.

AI.title_translation: SpatialV2A：视觉引导的高保真空间音频生成
AI.tldr: 我们构建了首个大规模视频-双耳音频数据集（BinauralVGGSound），并提出了SpatialV2A框架，该框架包含一个空间化模块，用于生成视觉引导的高保真、沉浸式空间音频，性能显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频转音频（V2A）模型主要关注语义和时间对齐，但忽略了空间感知和合成音频的沉浸式质量。其根本原因在于当前模型依赖单声道音频数据集，缺乏学习视觉到空间音频映射所需的双耳空间信息。
AI.method: 提出了两项关键贡献：1) 构建了首个大规模的视频-双耳音频数据集BinauralVGGSound，以支持空间感知的视频转音频生成。2) 提出了一个由视觉线索引导的端到端空间音频生成框架（SpatialV2A），该框架明确地对空间特征进行建模，并整合了一个视觉引导的音频空间化模块。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在空间保真度方面显著优于现有最先进的模型，提供了更具沉浸感的听觉体验，同时没有牺牲时间或语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架和数据集成功解决了空间音频生成中的差距，实现了卓越的空间保真度和沉浸感。所有数据集、代码和模型检查点都将公开发布，以促进未来的研究。
AI.translation: 尽管视频转音频（V2A）生成在语义和时间对齐方面取得了显著进展，但大多数现有研究仅关注这些方面，对合成音频的空间感知和沉浸式质量关注有限。这种局限性主要源于当前模型依赖单声道音频数据集，缺乏学习视觉到空间音频映射所需的双耳空间信息。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了两项关键贡献：我们构建了BinauralVGGSound，这是第一个旨在支持空间感知视频转音频生成的大规模视频-双耳音频数据集；我们提出了一个由视觉线索引导的端到端空间音频生成框架，该框架明确地对空间特征进行建模。我们的框架包含一个视觉引导的音频空间化模块，确保生成的音频表现出逼真的空间属性和分层的空间深度，同时保持语义和时间一致性。实验表明，我们的方法在空间保真度方面显著优于现有最先进的模型，并提供了更具沉浸感的听觉体验，而没有牺牲时间或语义一致性。所有数据集、代码和模型检查点都将公开发布，以促进未来的研究。
AI.summary: 本文解决了现有视频转音频（V2A）生成中空间保真度不足的问题，该问题源于对单声道数据集的依赖。作者构建了首个大规模视频-双耳音频数据集BinauralVGGSound，并提出了SpatialV2A——一个带有空间化模块的视觉引导框架，用于明确建模空间特征。实验证明，该方法在保持语义和时间一致性的同时，实现了优于现有最先进方法的空间保真度和沉浸感。
AI.keywords: 空间音频生成, 视频转音频, 双耳音频, 视觉引导, 空间保真度
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将视频转音频的研究从单纯的语义/时间对齐推进到沉浸式空间感知领域。构建首个大规模视频-双耳音频数据集（BinauralVGGSound）是至关重要的推动步骤，解决了先前限制空间V2A建模的基本数据瓶颈。提出的视觉引导空间化模块是生成逼真分层空间深度的关键技术。

title: Risk Estimation for Automated Driving
summary: Safety is a central requirement for automated vehicles. As such, the assessment of risk in automated driving is key in supporting both motion planning technologies and safety evaluation. In automated driving, risk is characterized by two aspects. The first aspect is the uncertainty on the state estimates of other road participants by an automated vehicle. The second aspect is the severity of a collision event with said traffic participants. Here, the uncertainty aspect typically causes the risk to be non-zero for near-collision events. This makes risk particularly useful for automated vehicle motion planning. Namely, constraining or minimizing risk naturally navigates the automated vehicle around traffic participants while keeping a safety distance based on the level of uncertainty and the potential severity of the impending collision. Existing approaches to calculate the risk either resort to empirical modeling or severe approximations, and, hence, lack generalizability and accuracy. In this paper, we combine recent advances in collision probability estimation with the concept of collision severity to develop a general method for accurate risk estimation. The proposed method allows us to assign individual severity functions for different collision constellations, such as, e.g., frontal or side collisions. Furthermore, we show that the proposed approach is computationally efficient, which is beneficial, e.g., in real-time motion planning applications. The programming code for an exemplary implementation of Gaussian uncertainties is also provided.

AI.tldr: 我们提出了一种通用、准确且计算高效的自动驾驶风险估计方法，它结合了先进的碰撞概率估计和碰撞严重程度函数，适用于实时运动规划。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中，安全是核心要求，风险评估对于支持运动规划技术和安全评估至关重要。现有风险计算方法依赖经验模型或严重的近似，因此缺乏通用性和准确性。
AI.method: 结合最新的碰撞概率估计进展与碰撞严重程度概念，开发了一种通用的准确风险估计方法。该方法允许为不同的碰撞情况（如正面或侧面碰撞）分配单独的严重程度函数。
AI.result: 提出的方法被证明是准确且计算高效的，这有利于实时运动规划应用。此外，还提供了高斯不确定性示例实现的编程代码。
AI.translation: 安全是自动驾驶汽车的核心要求。因此，自动驾驶中的风险评估对于支持运动规划技术和安全评估至关重要。在自动驾驶中，风险由两个方面表征。第一个方面是自动驾驶汽车对其他道路参与者状态估计的不确定性。第二个方面是与所述交通参与者发生碰撞事件的严重程度。其中，不确定性方面通常会导致近碰撞事件的风险不为零。这使得风险对于自动驾驶汽车的运动规划特别有用。即，约束或最小化风险可以自然地引导自动驾驶汽车避开交通参与者，同时根据不确定性水平和潜在碰撞的严重程度保持安全距离。现有的风险计算方法要么诉诸经验建模，要么诉诸严重的近似，因此缺乏通用性和准确性。在本文中，我们将碰撞概率估计的最新进展与碰撞严重程度的概念相结合，开发了一种准确风险估计的通用方法。所提出的方法允许我们为不同的碰撞组合（例如正面或侧面碰撞）分配单独的严重程度函数。此外，我们证明了所提出的方法具有计算效率，这对于例如实时运动规划应用是有益的。我们还提供了高斯不确定性示例实现的编程代码。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通用且准确的自动驾驶风险估计方法，旨在解决现有方法缺乏通用性和准确性的问题。该方法将先进的碰撞概率估计与碰撞严重程度概念相结合，允许为不同碰撞类型定制严重程度函数。由于其计算效率高，该方法特别适用于实时运动规划和安全评估。
AI.keywords: 风险估计, 自动驾驶, 碰撞概率, 碰撞严重程度, 运动规划
AI.comments: 创新点在于将先进的碰撞概率模型与可定制的碰撞严重程度函数相结合，形成一个通用且准确的风险评估框架。强调计算效率解决了自动驾驶中实时应用的关键挑战。该方法将风险分解为“不确定性”和“严重性”两部分，为运动规划提供了明确的优化目标，是自动驾驶安全决策支持的重要进步。

title: Mixture-of-Experts Models in Vision: Routing, Optimization, and Generalization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable conditional computation by routing inputs to multiple expert subnetworks and are often motivated as a mechanism for scaling large language models. In this project, we instead study MoE behavior in an image classification setting, focusing on predictive performance, expert utilization, and generalization. We compare dense, SoftMoE, and SparseMoE classifier heads on the CIFAR10 dataset under comparable model capacity. Both MoE variants achieve slightly higher validation accuracy than the dense baseline while maintaining balanced expert utilization through regularization, avoiding expert collapse. To analyze generalization, we compute Hessian-based sharpness metrics at convergence, including the largest eigenvalue and trace of the loss Hessian, evaluated on both training and test data. We find that SoftMoE exhibits higher sharpness by these metrics, while Dense and SparseMoE lie in a similar curvature regime, despite all models achieving comparable generalization performance. Complementary loss surface perturbation analyses reveal qualitative differences in non-local behavior under finite parameter perturbations between dense and MoE models, which help contextualize curvature-based measurements without directly explaining validation accuracy. We further evaluate empirical inference efficiency and show that naively implemented conditional routing does not yield inference speedups on modern hardware at this scale, highlighting the gap between theoretical and realized efficiency in sparse MoE models.

AI.title_translation: 视觉中的专家混合模型：路由、优化与泛化
AI.tldr: 本文研究了专家混合（MoE）模型在图像分类任务中的行为，比较了不同MoE变体与密集基线模型在预测性能、专家利用率和泛化能力方面的表现，并分析了推理效率。
AI.motivation: MoE架构通常被用于扩展大型语言模型，但本文旨在图像分类环境中研究MoE行为，特别关注预测性能、专家利用率和泛化能力。
AI.method: 研究团队在CIFAR10数据集上比较了密集、SoftMoE和SparseMoE分类器头，模型容量相当。他们通过正则化来维持专家利用率平衡。为了分析泛化能力，计算了收敛时的基于Hessian的锐度指标（包括损失Hessian的最大特征值和迹），并在训练和测试数据上进行评估。此外，还进行了互补的损失表面扰动分析，并评估了经验推理效率。
AI.result: MoE变体比密集基线模型取得了略高的验证准确率，并通过正则化保持了平衡的专家利用率，避免了专家崩溃。SoftMoE在Hessian锐度指标上表现出更高的锐度，而密集和SparseMoE则处于相似的曲率区域，尽管所有模型都达到了相当的泛化性能。损失表面扰动分析揭示了密集模型和MoE模型在有限参数扰动下非局部行为的定性差异。然而，天真实现的条件路由在现代硬件上并未带来推理速度提升，揭示了稀疏MoE模型在理论和实际效率之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: MoE模型在图像分类中可以实现与密集模型相当或略优的预测性能和泛化能力，同时保持专家利用率平衡。然而，基于Hessian的锐度指标并不能直接解释所有模型的泛化性能。此外，在当前规模下，天真实现的条件路由并未带来实际的推理效率提升，表明稀疏MoE模型在实现理论效率方面仍面临挑战。
AI.translation: 专家混合（MoE）架构通过将输入路由到多个专家子网络来实现条件计算，通常被视为扩展大型语言模型的机制。本项目转而研究MoE在图像分类环境中的行为，重点关注预测性能、专家利用率和泛化能力。我们在可比模型容量下，在CIFAR10数据集上比较了密集、SoftMoE和SparseMoE分类器头。两种MoE变体都比密集基线模型取得了略高的验证准确率，同时通过正则化保持了平衡的专家利用率，避免了专家崩溃。为了分析泛化能力，我们计算了收敛时基于Hessian的锐度指标，包括损失Hessian的最大特征值和迹，并在训练和测试数据上进行评估。我们发现，SoftMoE在这些指标上表现出更高的锐度，而密集和SparseMoE则处于相似的曲率区域，尽管所有模型都实现了相当的泛化性能。互补的损失表面扰动分析揭示了密集模型和MoE模型在有限参数扰动下非局部行为的定性差异，这有助于在不直接解释验证准确率的情况下，对基于曲率的测量进行情境化。我们进一步评估了经验推理效率，并表明在此规模下，天真实现的条件路由在现代硬件上并未带来推理速度提升，凸显了稀疏MoE模型在理论和实际效率之间的差距。
AI.summary: 本文在图像分类背景下研究了专家混合（MoE）模型的行为，比较了密集、SoftMoE和SparseMoE分类器在CIFAR10数据集上的性能。研究发现，MoE变体在验证准确率上略优于密集基线，并通过正则化保持了专家利用率平衡。尽管所有模型泛化性能相当，SoftMoE在基于Hessian的锐度指标上表现出更高锐度。此外，研究指出，在当前规模下，天真实现的条件路由在现代硬件上未能带来推理速度提升，揭示了稀疏MoE模型在理论与实际效率之间的差距。
AI.keywords: 专家混合模型, 图像分类, 路由, 泛化, 推理效率
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将MoE模型应用于图像分类任务，并深入分析了其在预测性能、专家利用率和泛化能力方面的表现。研究通过Hessian分析和损失表面扰动分析，提供了对MoE模型泛化行为的细致洞察。其重要性在于揭示了MoE模型在视觉任务中的潜力，同时也明确指出了当前MoE模型在实际推理效率上存在的局限性，即理论上的稀疏性优势在实际硬件上并未完全体现，这为未来MoE模型的设计和优化提供了重要的研究方向。

title: ExPrIS: Knowledge-Level Expectations as Priors for Object Interpretation from Sensor Data
comments: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this article is published in KI - Künstliche Intelligenz, and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13218-026-00901-7
summary: While deep learning has significantly advanced robotic object recognition, purely data-driven approaches often lack semantic consistency and fail to leverage valuable, pre-existing knowledge about the environment. This report presents the ExPrIS project, which addresses this challenge by investigating how knowledge-level expectations can serve as to improve object interpretation from sensor data. Our approach is based on the incremental construction of a 3D Semantic Scene Graph (3DSSG). We integrate expectations from two sources: contextual priors from past observations and semantic knowledge from external graphs like ConceptNet. These are embedded into a heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (GNN) to create an expectation-biased inference process. This method moves beyond static, frame-by-frame analysis to enhance the robustness and consistency of scene understanding over time. The report details this architecture, its evaluation, and outlines its planned integration on a mobile robotic platform.

AI.title_translation: ExPrIS：将知识级期望作为先验用于传感器数据的对象解释
AI.tldr: ExPrIS项目提出了一种利用知识级期望作为先验的方法，通过增量构建3D语义场景图（3DSSG）并将其嵌入异构图神经网络（GNN）中，从而超越静态分析，提高机器人对象解释的鲁棒性和语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人对象识别深度学习方法纯粹依赖数据驱动，缺乏语义一致性，并且未能利用环境中有价值的预先存在知识。
AI.method: 该方法基于3D语义场景图（3DSSG）的增量构建。它将两种期望来源（来自过去观察的上下文先验和来自ConceptNet等外部图的语义知识）整合，并嵌入到异构图神经网络（GNN）中，以创建一个期望偏置的推理过程，从而实现超越静态、逐帧分析的场景理解。
AI.result: 报告详细介绍了该架构及其评估。（具体评估结果未在摘要中提及，但提到了报告包含评估。）
AI.translation: 尽管深度学习极大地推动了机器人对象识别的进步，但纯粹的数据驱动方法往往缺乏语义一致性，并且未能利用关于环境的有价值的预先存在知识。本报告介绍了ExPrIS项目，该项目通过研究知识级期望如何作为先验来改进传感器数据的对象解释，从而应对这一挑战。我们的方法基于3D语义场景图（3DSSG）的增量构建。我们整合了两种来源的期望：来自过去观察的上下文先验和来自ConceptNet等外部图的语义知识。这些期望被嵌入到一个异构图神经网络（GNN）中，以创建一个期望偏置的推理过程。该方法超越了静态、逐帧分析，增强了场景理解随时间的鲁棒性和一致性。报告详细介绍了该架构、其评估，并概述了其在移动机器人平台上的计划集成。
AI.summary: ExPrIS项目提出了一种利用知识级期望作为先验来增强机器人对象解释的方法。该方法通过增量构建3D语义场景图（3DSSG），整合了来自历史观察的上下文先验和来自外部知识图（如ConceptNet）的语义知识。这些先验被输入到一个异构图神经网络（GNN）中，创建了一个期望偏置的推理过程，旨在提高场景理解在时间上的鲁棒性和一致性，克服了纯数据驱动方法缺乏语义一致性的问题。
AI.keywords: 知识级期望, 3D语义场景图, 异构图神经网络, 对象解释, 机器人感知
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将高层次的“知识级期望”显式地融入到基于深度学习的感知管道中，特别是通过使用异构图神经网络（GNN）来整合多源先验知识（上下文和外部语义图）。这解决了传统深度学习在机器人领域中语义一致性差和缺乏知识利用的问题，使得场景理解能够从静态的逐帧分析转向更具时间连贯性和鲁棒性的解释。未来在移动机器人平台上的集成计划凸显了其潜在的实际应用价值。

title: Information mechanics: conservation and exchange
summary: Inference and learning are commonly cast in terms of optimisation, yet the fundamental constraints governing uncertainty reduction remain unclear. This work presents a first-principles framework inherent to Bayesian updating, termed information mechanics (infomechanics). Any pointwise reduction in posterior surprisal is exactly balanced by information gained from data, independently of algorithms, dynamics, or implementation. Imposing additivity, symmetry, and robustness collapses the freedom of this identity to only two independent conservation relations. One governs the global redistribution of uncertainty and recovers Shannon entropy. The other captures a complementary local geometric component, formalised as Fisher information. Together, these conserved quantities motivate a non-additive state function, the information potential $Φ$, which isolates structural degrees of freedom beyond entropy while remaining invariant under reparametrisation. $Φ$ quantifies local sharpness and ruggedness in posterior beliefs and vanishes uniquely for isotropic Gaussian distributions. In a low-temperature regime, $Φ$ scales logarithmically with the effective number of local optima, linking information geometry to computational complexity. This formalises an information-computation exchange, whereby information acquisition reshapes the inference landscape and reduces computational demands. By separating invariant informational constraints from inference mechanisms, this framework provides a unified, algorithm-independent foundation for inference, learning, and computation across biological and artificial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“信息力学”框架，基于贝叶斯更新的首要原理，确立了两个独立的守恒关系（香农熵和费舍尔信息）。它引入了信息势$\Phi$，量化了后验信念的局部几何特征，并形式化了信息获取与计算需求之间的交换关系，为推断和学习提供了算法无关的基础。
AI.motivation: 推断和学习通常被视为优化问题，但控制不确定性降低的基本约束尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯更新的首要原理框架，即信息力学（infomechanics）。通过施加可加性、对称性和鲁棒性，推导出两个独立的守恒关系（香农熵和费舍尔信息），并定义了一个非加性状态函数——信息势（$\Phi$）。
AI.result: 任何后验惊奇程度的逐点降低都与从数据中获得的信息精确平衡。恢复了两个独立的守恒关系：香农熵和费舍尔信息。提出了信息势 $\Phi$，它量化了后验信念的局部几何特征，在低温度状态下，它与计算复杂性相关（与有效局部最优数量的对数成比例），从而形式化了信息-计算交换。
AI.conclusion: 通过将不变的信息约束与推断机制分离，该框架为生物和人工系统中的推断、学习和计算提供了一个统一的、算法无关的基础。
AI.translation: 推断和学习通常被视为优化问题，然而，控制不确定性降低的基本约束仍然不清楚。这项工作提出了一个固有于贝叶斯更新的首要原理框架，称为信息力学（infomechanics）。后验惊奇程度的任何逐点降低都与从数据中获得的信息精确平衡，这与算法、动力学或实现方式无关。施加可加性、对称性和鲁棒性将这一恒等式的自由度收敛到仅两个独立的守恒关系。其中一个控制着不确定性的全局重新分配，并恢复了香农熵。另一个捕获了一个互补的局部几何分量，形式化为费舍尔信息。这两个守恒量共同激发了一个非加性状态函数——信息势 $\Phi$，它在熵之外分离了结构自由度，同时在重新参数化下保持不变。$\Phi$ 量化了后验信念中的局部尖锐度和崎岖度，并且仅对各向同性高斯分布消失。在低温度状态下，$\Phi$ 与有效局部最优数量呈对数关系，从而将信息几何与计算复杂性联系起来。这形式化了信息-计算交换，即信息获取重塑了推断景观并降低了计算需求。通过将不变的信息约束与推断机制分离，该框架为生物和人工系统中的推断、学习和计算提供了一个统一的、算法无关的基础。
AI.summary: 本文引入了基于贝叶斯更新的“信息力学”框架，旨在阐明不确定性降低的基本约束。该框架证明了后验惊奇程度的减少与数据信息增益的精确平衡。通过施加基本性质，它推导出了两个独立的守恒量：香农熵（全局不确定性）和费舍尔信息（局部几何）。基于这些守恒量，作者提出了信息势 $\Phi$，它是一个非加性状态函数，用于量化后验信念的局部复杂性，并揭示了信息几何与计算复杂性之间的联系，从而形式化了信息获取与计算需求之间的交换关系。
AI.keywords: 信息力学, 贝叶斯更新, 守恒律, 费舍尔信息, 信息势
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个基于贝叶斯更新的“信息力学”首要原理框架，将推断和学习的分析从优化视角提升到基本约束层面。其重要性在于，它将香农熵和费舍尔信息统一为两个独立的守恒关系，并引入了信息势 ($\Phi$) 作为一种新的、与参数化无关的状态函数，成功地将信息几何的局部特征（尖锐度/崎岖度）与计算复杂性联系起来，形式化了信息-计算交换。这为理解和设计生物及人工系统中的推断过程提供了深刻的理论基础。

title: Emergent, not Immanent: A Baradian Reading of Explainable AI
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) is frequently positioned as a technical problem of revealing the inner workings of an AI model. This position is affected by unexamined onto-epistemological assumptions: meaning is treated as immanent to the model, the explainer is positioned outside the system, and a causal structure is presumed recoverable through computational techniques. In this paper, we draw on Barad's agential realism to develop an alternative onto-epistemology of XAI. We propose that interpretations are material-discursive performances that emerge from situated entanglements of the AI model with humans, context, and the interpretative apparatus. To develop this position, we read a comprehensive set of XAI methods through agential realism and reveal the assumptions and limitations that underpin several of these methods. We then articulate the framework's ethical dimension and propose design directions for XAI interfaces that support emergent interpretation, using a speculative text-to-music interface as a case study.

AI.title_translation: 涌现而非内在：对可解释人工智能的一种巴拉德式解读
AI.tldr: 本文利用巴拉德的能动实在论，提出了一种新的可解释人工智能（XAI）的本体-认识论框架，认为解释是AI模型、人类和环境情境交织中涌现出的物质-话语性表演，并基于此批判了现有XAI方法的局限性，并提出了支持涌现式解释的XAI界面设计方向。
AI.motivation: 现有的可解释人工智能（XAI）研究通常将解释视为揭示AI模型内在运作的技术问题，但这种立场基于未经检验的本体-认识论假设，即意义内在（immanent）于模型、解释者外在于系统、且因果结构可通过计算技术恢复。本文旨在利用巴拉德（Barad）的能动实在论（agential realism）来发展一种替代性的XAI本体-认识论。
AI.method: 1. 借鉴巴拉德的能动实在论，提出解释是源于AI模型、人类、情境和解释装置的具身纠缠（situated entanglements）的物质-话语性涌现表演。2. 利用能动实在论的视角，阅读和分析一整套现有的XAI方法，揭示其潜在的假设和局限性。3. 阐明该框架的伦理维度，并提出支持涌现式解释的XAI界面设计方向，以一个推测性的文本到音乐界面作为案例研究。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了现有XAI方法背后的假设和局限性。2. 阐明了新框架的伦理维度。3. 提出了支持涌现式解释的XAI界面的设计方向，并使用一个文本到音乐界面进行了案例研究。
AI.translation: 可解释人工智能（XAI）通常被定位为一个揭示AI模型内部工作原理的技术问题。这种定位受到未经审查的本体-认识论假设的影响：意义被视为内在（immanent）于模型，解释者被置于系统之外，并且假设计算技术可以恢复因果结构。在本文中，我们借鉴巴拉德的能动实在论来发展一种替代性的XAI本体-认识论。我们提出，解释是物质-话语性的表演，它们从AI模型与人类、情境和解释装置的具身纠缠中涌现出来。为了发展这一立场，我们通过能动实在论解读了一整套全面的XAI方法，并揭示了其中几种方法背后的假设和局限性。随后，我们阐明了该框架的伦理维度，并提出了支持涌现式解释的XAI界面的设计方向，同时使用一个推测性的文本到音乐界面作为案例研究。
AI.summary: 本文批判了传统XAI研究中将解释视为揭示模型内在意义的技术问题的本体-认识论假设。作者引入巴拉德的能动实在论，提出了一种替代性的XAI框架，认为解释是AI模型、用户、情境和解释工具相互纠缠中“涌现”出的物质-话语性表演。该研究利用这一新视角分析了现有的XAI方法，揭示了其局限性，并进一步阐述了该框架的伦理意义，最终提出了支持这种涌现式解释的新型XAI界面的设计指导方针，并通过一个文本到音乐接口进行了概念验证。
AI.keywords: 可解释人工智能, 能动实在论, 涌现式解释, 本体-认识论, 物质-话语性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将社会科学和哲学理论（巴拉德的能动实在论）引入到通常被视为纯粹技术领域的XAI研究中，从而对XAI的底层本体-认识论基础进行了深刻的反思和批判。其重要性在于，它将解释从模型内部的静态属性（内在性）转向了动态、情境化的互动过程（涌现性），这为设计更具伦理性和情境敏感性的XAI系统提供了新的理论基础和设计方向。这种跨学科的视角挑战了主流计算主义的解释范式，强调了解释作为一种具身、物质和话语实践的复杂性。

title: Visual and Cognitive Demands of a Large Language Model-Powered In-vehicle Conversational Agent
summary: Driver distraction remains a leading contributor to motor vehicle crashes, necessitating rigorous evaluation of new in-vehicle technologies. This study assessed the visual and cognitive demands associated with an advanced Large Language Model (LLM) conversational agent (Gemini Live) during on-road driving, comparing it against handsfree phone calls, visual turn-by-turn guidance (low load baseline), and the Operation Span (OSPAN) task (high load anchor). Thirty-two licensed drivers completed five secondary tasks while visual and cognitive demands were measured using the Detection Response Task (DRT) for cognitive load, eye-tracking for visual attention, and subjective workload ratings. Results indicated that Gemini Live interactions (both single-turn and multi-turn) and hands-free phone calls shared similar levels of cognitive load, between that of visual turn-by-turn guidance and OSPAN. Exploratory analysis showed that cognitive load remained stable across extended multi-turn conversations. All tasks maintained mean glance durations well below the well-established 2-second safety threshold, confirming low visual demand. Furthermore, drivers consistently dedicated longer glances to the roadway between brief off-road glances toward the device during task completion, particularly during voice-based interactions, rendering longer total-eyes-off-road time findings less consequential. Subjective ratings mirrored objective data, with participants reporting low effort, demands, and perceived distraction for Gemini Live. These findings demonstrate that advanced LLM conversational agents, when implemented via voice interfaces, impose cognitive and visual demands comparable to established, low-risk hands-free benchmarks, supporting their safe deployment in the driving environment.

AI.title_translation: 基于大型语言模型驱动的车载对话代理的视觉和认知需求
AI.tldr: 车载LLM语音代理（Gemini Live）的视觉和认知需求较低，与安全的免提电话相当，支持其在驾驶环境中的安全部署。
AI.motivation: 驾驶员分心仍然是机动车事故的主要原因，因此需要对新的车载技术进行严格评估。
AI.method: 在实际道路驾驶中，评估了先进的大型语言模型（LLM）对话代理（Gemini Live）的视觉和认知需求。将其与免提电话、视觉逐向导航（低负荷基线）和操作跨度任务（OSPAN，高负荷锚点）进行了比较。使用检测反应任务（DRT）测量认知负荷，使用眼动追踪测量视觉注意力，并使用主观工作负荷评分对32名持照驾驶员进行了测量。
AI.result: Gemini Live交互（单轮和多轮）与免提电话的认知负荷水平相似，介于视觉逐向导航和OSPAN之间。扩展的多轮对话中认知负荷保持稳定。所有任务的平均注视持续时间远低于2秒的安全阈值，证实了低视觉需求。驾驶员在短暂的偏离道路注视设备之间，会持续更长时间地注视道路。主观评分与客观数据一致，报告Gemini Live的努力程度、需求和感知分心程度较低。
AI.conclusion: 通过语音界面实现的先进LLM对话代理所施加的认知和视觉需求，与已建立的低风险免提基准相当，支持它们在驾驶环境中的安全部署。
AI.translation: 驾驶员分心仍然是机动车事故的主要原因，因此需要对新的车载技术进行严格评估。本研究评估了先进的大型语言模型（LLM）对话代理（Gemini Live）在实际道路驾驶中相关的视觉和认知需求，并将其与免提电话、视觉逐向导航（低负荷基线）以及操作跨度任务（OSPAN，高负荷锚点）进行了比较。三十二名持照驾驶员完成了五项次要任务，同时使用检测反应任务（DRT）测量认知负荷，使用眼动追踪测量视觉注意力，并使用主观工作负荷评分测量视觉和认知需求。结果表明，Gemini Live交互（无论是单轮还是多轮）和免提电话具有相似的认知负荷水平，介于视觉逐向导航和OSPAN之间。探索性分析显示，在扩展的多轮对话中，认知负荷保持稳定。所有任务的平均注视持续时间都远低于公认的2秒安全阈值，证实了低视觉需求。此外，驾驶员在完成任务期间，在短暂地偏离道路注视设备之后，会持续更长时间地注视道路，尤其是在基于语音的交互过程中，这使得总离路注视时间较长的发现变得不那么重要。主观评分与客观数据一致，参与者报告Gemini Live的努力程度、需求和感知分心程度较低。这些发现表明，通过语音界面实现的先进LLM对话代理所施加的认知和视觉需求，与已建立的低风险免提基准相当，支持它们在驾驶环境中的安全部署。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了在实际道路驾驶中使用LLM驱动的车载对话代理（Gemini Live）时的视觉和认知需求，并将其与免提电话和视觉导航进行了比较。对32名驾驶员使用DRT、眼动追踪和主观评分进行测量，结果显示Gemini Live的认知负荷与免提电话相似，介于低负荷导航和高负荷OSPAN之间。视觉需求较低，注视持续时间低于2秒的安全阈值。研究结果表明，基于语音的LLM代理与已建立的低风险免提基准相当，支持其在车辆中的安全部署。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 对话代理, 驾驶员分心, 认知需求, 视觉需求
AI.comments: 本研究的重要性在于它在驾驶这一高风险安全背景下，对尖端技术（LLM对话代理，特别是Gemini Live）进行了严格的评估。其创新之处在于使用了已建立的客观测量方法（DRT、眼动追踪）和主观评分，将LLM交互的需求与已知的安全（免提电话）和高负荷（OSPAN）活动进行了基准比较。研究结果表明，基于语音的LLM代理与低风险基准相当，这对于行业采用和安全监管至关重要。

title: Factorizable joint shift revisited
summary: Factorizable joint shift (FJS) was proposed as a type of distribution shift (or dataset shift) that comprises both covariate and label shift. Recently, it has been observed that FJS actually arises from consecutive label and covariate (or vice versa) shifts. Research into FJS so far has been confined to the case of categorical label spaces. We propose a framework for analysing distribution shift in the case of general label spaces, thus covering both classification and regression models. Based on the framework, we generalise existing results on FJS to general label spaces and propose a related extension of the expectation maximisation (EM) algorithm for class prior probabilities. We also take a fresh look at generalized label shift (GLS) in the case of general label spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了可分解联合漂移（FJS），提出了一种适用于一般标签空间（包括分类和回归）的分布漂移分析框架。基于此框架，作者推广了FJS的现有结果，并提出了期望最大化（EM）算法的扩展，同时还分析了广义标签漂移（GLS）。
AI.motivation: 现有的可分解联合漂移（FJS）研究一直局限于分类标签空间的情况。本文旨在提出一个适用于一般标签空间（涵盖分类和回归）的框架，以推广FJS的现有结果。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个用于分析一般标签空间中分布漂移的框架，该框架涵盖了分类和回归模型。基于此框架，作者推广了FJS的现有结果，并提出了针对类别先验概率的期望最大化（EM）算法的扩展。此外，还重新审视了一般标签空间中的广义标签漂移（GLS）。
AI.result: 成功将可分解联合漂移（FJS）的现有结果推广至一般标签空间，并提出了相关的期望最大化（EM）算法扩展。
AI.translation: 可分解联合漂移（FJS）被提出作为一种包含协变量漂移和标签漂移的分布漂移（或数据集漂移）类型。最近，人们观察到FJS实际上源于连续的标签和协变量漂移（或反之）。迄今为止，对FJS的研究一直局限于分类标签空间的情况。我们提出了一个用于分析一般标签空间中分布漂移的框架，从而涵盖了分类和回归模型。基于该框架，我们将FJS的现有结果推广到一般标签空间，并提出了类别先验概率的期望最大化（EM）算法的相关扩展。我们还重新审视了一般标签空间中的广义标签漂移（GLS）。
AI.summary: 可分解联合漂移（FJS）是一种包含协变量和标签漂移的分布漂移类型，但其研究此前仅限于分类标签空间。本文提出了一个分析一般标签空间中分布漂移的通用框架，该框架可应用于分类和回归模型。利用此框架，本文将FJS的现有结果推广到一般标签空间，并提出了用于类别先验概率的期望最大化（EM）算法的扩展，同时对一般标签空间中的广义标签漂移（GLS）进行了新的考察。
AI.keywords: 可分解联合漂移 (FJS), 分布漂移, 一般标签空间, 期望最大化 (EM), 广义标签漂移 (GLS)
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于打破了可分解联合漂移（FJS）研究仅限于分类标签空间的限制，通过提出一个通用框架，将其分析范围扩展到了包含回归任务的一般标签空间。这种推广对于处理更复杂的实际数据集漂移问题至关重要，特别是对于那些标签空间是连续值的任务。提出的EM算法扩展可能为实际应用中校正类别先验概率提供新的工具。

title: Knowledge Restoration-driven Prompt Optimization: Unlocking LLM Potential for Open-Domain Relational Triplet Extraction
summary: Open-domain Relational Triplet Extraction (ORTE) is the foundation for mining structured knowledge without predefined schemas. Despite the impressive in-context learning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), existing methods are hindered by their reliance on static, heuristic-driven prompting strategies. Due to the lack of reflection mechanisms required to internalize erroneous signals, these methods exhibit vulnerability in semantic ambiguity, often making erroneous extraction patterns permanent. To address this bottleneck, we propose a Knowledge Reconstruction-driven Prompt Optimization (KRPO) framework to assist LLMs in continuously improving their extraction capabilities for complex ORTE task flows. Specifically, we design a self-evaluation mechanism based on knowledge restoration, which provides intrinsic feedback signals by projecting structured triplets into semantic consistency scores. Subsequently, we propose a prompt optimizer based on a textual gradient that can internalize historical experiences to iteratively optimize prompts, which can better guide LLMs to handle subsequent extraction tasks. Furthermore, to alleviate relation redundancy, we design a relation canonicalization memory that collects representative relations and provides semantically distinct schemas for the triplets. Extensive experiments across three datasets show that KRPO significantly outperforms strong baselines in the extraction F1 score.

AI.title_translation: 知识恢复驱动的提示优化：释放LLM在开放域关系三元组抽取中的潜力
AI.tldr: 针对开放域关系三元组抽取（ORTE）中LLM提示静态且缺乏反馈的问题，本文提出了KRPO框架。该框架使用知识恢复进行自评估，并通过文本梯度优化提示，显著提高了抽取F1分数。
AI.motivation: 开放域关系三元组抽取（ORTE）是基础知识挖掘任务，但现有方法依赖静态、启发式提示策略。由于缺乏内化错误信号所需的反射机制，它们容易受到语义模糊性的影响，并使错误的抽取模式永久化。
AI.method: 提出知识重建驱动的提示优化（KRPO）框架。具体包括：1. 基于知识恢复的自评估机制，通过将结构化三元组投射到语义一致性分数来提供内在反馈信号。2. 基于文本梯度的提示优化器，用于内化历史经验并迭代优化提示。3. 关系规范化记忆，用于收集代表性关系并提供语义上不同的模式以减轻关系冗余。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的广泛实验表明，KRPO在抽取F1分数上显著优于强大的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的知识重建驱动的提示优化（KRPO）框架成功解决了现有LLM方法在ORTE任务中静态提示和缺乏反馈机制的瓶颈，显著提升了LLM的抽取性能。
AI.translation: 开放域关系三元组抽取（ORTE）是挖掘无预定义模式结构化知识的基础。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）具有令人印象深刻的上下文学习能力，但现有方法仍受限于其对静态、启发式驱动提示策略的依赖。由于缺乏内化错误信号所需的反射机制，这些方法在语义模糊性方面表现出脆弱性，通常会使错误的抽取模式永久化。为了解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了一个知识重建驱动的提示优化（KRPO）框架，以帮助LLM持续改进其处理复杂ORTE任务流程的抽取能力。具体来说，我们设计了一种基于知识恢复的自评估机制，通过将结构化三元组投射到语义一致性分数来提供内在反馈信号。随后，我们提出了一个基于文本梯度的提示优化器，它可以内化历史经验以迭代优化提示，从而更好地指导LLM处理后续的抽取任务。此外，为了减轻关系冗余，我们设计了一个关系规范化记忆，用于收集代表性关系并为三元组提供语义上不同的模式。在三个数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，KRPO在抽取F1分数上显著优于强大的基线方法。
AI.summary: 开放域关系三元组抽取（ORTE）中的现有LLM方法因依赖静态启发式提示而效率低下，且容易使错误抽取模式永久化。为解决此问题，本文提出知识重建驱动的提示优化（KRPO）框架。KRPO包含基于知识恢复的自评估机制（提供内在反馈），以及基于文本梯度的提示优化器（迭代优化提示）。此外，还设计了关系规范化记忆来减轻关系冗余。实验证明KRPO在三个数据集上显著优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 知识恢复, 提示优化, 关系三元组抽取, LLM
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将“知识恢复”的概念引入到LLM的提示优化循环中，解决了现有LLM ORTE方法中缺乏内在反馈机制的重大限制。通过设计自评估机制（基于语义一致性分数）和基于文本梯度的优化器，KRPO提供了一个动态、可学习的提示策略，有效避免了错误抽取模式的固化。这种将结构化知识的反向投影作为反馈信号的方法，对于需要高准确性和一致性的知识抽取任务具有重要意义。

title: A Curriculum-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem
